sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份，却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请在您使用的应用或我们的网站上查看本期节目的节目文稿。

sentences.en: Ed Chambers would do anything for his wife Marguerite.
sentences.zh: 埃德·钱伯斯为了妻子玛格丽特愿意付出一切。

sentences.en: The couple who lived in the city of Grand Rapids, Michigan, were a team.
sentences.zh: 这对住在密歇根州大急流城的夫妻曾是一支默契的团队。

sentences.en: Together they had provided a safe and loving home for four children and built successful careers.
sentences.zh: 他们共同为四个孩子提供了一个安全、充满爱意的家，并各自成就了成功的事业。

sentences.en: But in 1972, Ed noticed a change in Marguerite's personality.
sentences.zh: 但在1972年，埃德注意到玛格丽特的性格发生了变化。

sentences.en: His highly intelligent and quick-witted wife became forgetful and confused.
sentences.zh: 他原本聪慧敏锐的妻子变得健忘而迷糊。

sentences.en: After seeking medical advice, the couple received devastating news.
sentences.zh: 在寻求医疗咨询后，夫妻俩得到了一个令人心碎的消息。

sentences.en: At 42 years old, Marguerite had Alzheimer's disease, an incurable type of dementia that destroys memory and thinking skills.
sentences.zh: 42岁的玛格丽特患上了阿尔茨海默病，这是一种无法治愈的痴呆症，会摧毁记忆和思维能力。

sentences.en: Over the following years, Marguerite became frail and was unable to carry out the simplest of everyday tasks.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，玛格丽特变得虚弱不堪，无法完成最简单的日常琐事。

sentences.en: Ed took an early retirement to help his wife, but by the early 1980s, he accepted that Marguerite needed round-the-clock care by professionals.
sentences.zh: 埃德选择提前退休来照顾妻子，但到了20世纪80年代初，他不得不接受现实：玛格丽特需要专业人员的24小时全天候护理。

sentences.en: Live-in care facilities around Grand Rapids at that time were few and far between, so Marguerite's name was added to a long list of applicants.
sentences.zh: 当时大急流城周边的全住家护理机构寥寥无几，因此玛格丽特的名字被加进了一份长长的申请名单中。

sentences.en: After a two-year wait, a bed became available at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 经过两年的等待，阿尔卑斯庄园疗养院终于空出了一张床位。

sentences.en: Situated on the outskirts of Grand Rapids and backing onto a densely wooded area, the 208-bed nursing home was only three blocks from the Chambers' house.
sentences.zh: 这家拥有208张床位的疗养院坐落在大急流城郊区，背靠一片茂密的树林，距离钱伯斯家只有三个街区。

sentences.en: This meant Ed could visit Marguerite as often as he wanted.
sentences.zh: 这意味着埃德可以随时去看望玛格丽特。

sentences.en: He couldn't believe his luck.
sentences.zh: 他简直不敢相信自己的运气。

sentences.en: When Ed Chambers approached the single-storey brick facility, he was greeted by the director of nursing who gave him a tour.
sentences.zh: 当埃德·钱伯斯走近这座单层的砖砌建筑时，护理主任迎上前去并带他参观。

sentences.en: Alpine Manor was divided into four wings.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯庄园分为四个侧楼。

sentences.en: Each wing had its own nursing station.
sentences.zh: 每个侧楼都有自己的护士站。

sentences.en: The facility was very clean and the staff were polite and well-presented.
sentences.zh: 这里非常干净，员工们也很有礼貌、仪态得体。

sentences.en: In a common area, residents sat together chatting and playing games.
sentences.zh: 在公共区域里，居民们坐在一起聊天、玩游戏。

sentences.en: Ed had anticipated that the nursing home would be sterile and cold, so he was delighted to see that the floors were carpeted,
sentences.zh: 埃德本以为疗养院会冷冰冰且毫无生气，所以当他看到地面铺着地毯时感到十分惊喜，

sentences.en: curtains hung from the windows, and artwork lined the walls.
sentences.zh: 窗户上挂着窗帘，墙上还挂着艺术品。

sentences.en: Residents could visit a beauty shop and there was a designated dining room for meals.
sentences.zh: 居民们可以光顾美发店，并且有指定的餐厅用餐。

sentences.en: There were even craft activities and social studies classes on offer.
sentences.zh: 这里甚至还提供手工活动和社交学习班。

sentences.en: Although Ed felt immense guilt at having to move Marguerite into Alpine Manor, its homely atmosphere helped ease some of the pain.
sentences.zh: 尽管把玛格丽特送进阿尔卑斯庄园让埃德感到无比内疚，但这里温馨的氛围缓解了一些痛苦。

sentences.en: The director of nursing reassured Ed, telling him that Alpine Manor had been assessed by the Michigan Health Department as a standout nursing home facility.
sentences.zh: 护理主任安慰埃德，告诉他阿尔卑斯庄园曾被密歇根州卫生部评为杰出的疗养机构。

sentences.en: By the mid-1980s, Marguerite Chambers could no longer walk or talk.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代中期，玛格丽特·钱伯斯已经无法行走或说话。

sentences.en: She spent all day in bed, often curled in a ball and rocking back and forth.
sentences.zh: 她整天躺在床上，经常蜷缩成一团，前后摇晃。

sentences.en: Ed still visited her every day.
sentences.zh: 埃德仍然每天都来看她。

sentences.en: The minute Marguerite heard his voice, she stopped rocking and reached her hand up for him to take.
sentences.zh: 一听到埃德的声音，玛格丽特就会停止摇晃，把手举起来让他握住。

sentences.en: He sat beside her, holding her hand and talking to her.
sentences.zh: 他坐在她身旁，握着她的手跟她说话。

sentences.en: Occasionally, she would make eye contact.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，她会与他对视。

sentences.en: Ed knew that she still recognised him.
sentences.zh: 埃德知道她依然认得自己。

sentences.en: Each night, Ed tucked Marguerite into bed and left her to the care of the staff at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，埃德为玛格丽特掖好被子，将她交托给阿尔卑斯庄园的工作人员照料。

sentences.en: 23-year-old Kathy Wood dreamed of working in healthcare.
sentences.zh: 23岁的凯茜·伍德梦想着从事医疗保健工作。

sentences.en: She had done voluntary work as a nursing assistant in high school and enjoyed helping people.
sentences.zh: 她在高中时就做过护理助理的志愿者，并且很喜欢帮助别人。

sentences.en: At age 17, Cathy's career was put on hold when she became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 17岁时，由于怀孕，凯茜的职业生涯被迫按下了暂停键。

sentences.en: Now that her daughter was at school, Cathy was eager to rekindle her passion for nursing.
sentences.zh: 如今女儿上了学，凯茜渴望重新点燃她对护理的热情。

sentences.en: A nursing home a few blocks away was hiring.
sentences.zh: 几个街区外的一家疗养院正在招聘。

sentences.en: Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯庄园。

sentences.en: Cathy Wood impressed management with her enthusiasm.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德的积极热情给管理层留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: She was hired as a nursing aide and started immediately.
sentences.zh: 她被聘为护理助理，并立即上岗。

sentences.en: Some residents only needed minor help, such as assistance with getting dressed or showering.
sentences.zh: 有些居民只需要轻微的帮助，比如协助穿衣或洗澡。

sentences.en: Others were high-needs residents who required help with daily living, such as eating and drinking, bathing, and turning in bed to prevent pressure sores.
sentences.zh: 另一些则是重度护理居民，需要协助日常生活，例如进食和饮水、洗澡以及在床上翻身以防止压疮。

sentences.en: Before long, Cathy came to know every resident and their specific needs.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，凯茜就熟悉了每一位居民及其特定的需求。

sentences.en: She was a hard worker, intelligent, and easy to talk to.
sentences.zh: 她工作勤奋、聪明伶俐且健谈。

sentences.en: Before long, she became a valued member of Alpine Manor's staff.
sentences.zh: 不久，她就成了阿尔卑斯庄园备受器重的员工。

sentences.en: Being a night owl, Kathy gravitated towards the night shift.
sentences.zh: 由于是个夜猫子，凯茜更倾向于上夜班。

sentences.en: It was less busy than day shifts and gave her more time to socialise with her co-workers.
sentences.zh: 夜班比白班清闲，这让她有更多时间与同事社交。

sentences.en: Nursing aides joked that Kathy was like one of the cool kids at high school because her colleagues followed her around, hanging off every word she said.
sentences.zh: 护理助理们开玩笑说，凯茜就像高中里那些酷炫的孩子，因为同事们总是前呼后拥地跟着她，对她说的每一句话言听计从。

sentences.en: Kathy Wood wasn't used to the attention.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德并不习惯这种关注。

sentences.en: She had struggled with her weight her entire life, reaching almost 450 pounds after the birth of her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她一生都在与体重作斗争，生完女儿后体重甚至达到了近450磅。

sentences.en: As a result, she spent most of her married life indoors, fearful of the judgement of strangers.
sentences.zh: 因此，她的大半个婚姻生活都是足不出户度过的，害怕陌生人的评头论足。

sentences.en: But at Alpine Manor, Cathy was showered with compliments.
sentences.zh: 但在阿尔卑斯庄园，凯茜却被赞美声包围了。

sentences.en: She began taking double shifts just to spend more time with her colleagues.
sentences.zh: 她开始主动要求上双倍班，只为了能和同事们多待一会儿。

sentences.en: Over the following months, Kathy's husband, Ken, watched as she changed before his eyes.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，凯茜的丈夫肯眼睁睁地看着妻子在自己面前发生改变。

sentences.en: Most of Kathy's days off were spent socialising with Alpine Manor staff.
sentences.zh: 凯茜的大部分休息日都用来和阿尔卑斯庄园的员工社交。

sentences.en: She never used to drink alcohol, but returned home from these get-togethers drunk and high on cannabis.
sentences.zh: 她过去从不喝酒，但从这些聚会回家时却常常喝得酩酊大醉、吸着大麻。

sentences.en: The once dedicated stay-at-home wife and mother now had little interest in spending time with her daughter and fought with Ken often.
sentences.zh: 这个曾经全心奉献的家庭主妇和母亲现在对花时间陪女儿毫无兴趣，并且经常和肯吵架。

sentences.en: When they weren't fighting, Kathy told Ken all the worker gossip.
sentences.zh: 不吵架的时候，凯茜就会把所有的员工八卦都告诉肯。

sentences.en: Love triangles among the nursing aides were common, as were drunken threesomes and altercations between love rivals.
sentences.zh: 护理助理之间的三角恋屡见不鲜，酒后3P以及情敌之间的冲突也是家常便饭。

sentences.en: Fighting among staff members often occurred at work while residents listened on, unable to extricate themselves from the toxic environment.
sentences.zh: 员工之间的争吵经常在工作时发生，而居民们则在一旁听着，无法从这个有毒的环境中脱身。

sentences.en: As Kathy pumped Ken full of staff secrets, he often thought to himself, what the hell is going on at Alpine Manor?
sentences.zh: 每当凯茜向肯灌输员工们的秘密时，他经常在心里想：阿尔卑斯庄园到底在搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: In September
1986, less than six months after Kathy Wood started working at Alpine Manor, she told Ken
sentences.zh: 9月，在凯茜·伍德开始在阿尔卑斯庄园工作不到六个月的时候，她告诉肯

sentences.en: that she had fallen in love with someone else, an 18-year-old fellow nursing aide named Dawn.
sentences.zh: 她爱上了另一个人，那是18岁的同行护理助理，名叫道恩。

sentences.en: After seven years of marriage, Kathy wanted a divorce.
sentences.zh: 结婚七年后，凯茜提出了离婚。

sentences.en: Ken believed she was going through a face and would return to him.
sentences.zh: 肯以为她只是一时头脑发热，最后还是会回到他身边。

sentences.en: In the meantime, he took their daughter to live in a hotel while Cathy remained in their family home.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他带着女儿搬到了一家酒店居住，而凯茜则留在了他们的家中。

sentences.en: Without Ken at home, Cathy needed help paying the bills.
sentences.zh: 由于家里没有了肯，凯茜需要人帮忙支付账单。

sentences.en: A staff member introduced her to a new nurse's aide at Alpine Manor,
sentences.zh: 一位员工将阿尔卑斯庄园的一名新护理助理介绍给了她，

sentences.en: 22-year-old Gwendolyn Graham, who went by the name Gwen.
sentences.zh: 她就是22岁的格温多琳·格雷厄姆，大家都叫她格温。

sentences.en: Gwen had no previous experience in nursing but had taken on the role as a stepping stone to become a paramedic.
sentences.zh: 格温没有任何护理经验，做这份工作只是她成为急救护理员的一个跳板。

sentences.en: Alpine Manor was chronically understaffed so, like Kathy, Gwen had been hired on the spot.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯庄园长期人手严重不足，所以和凯茜一样，格温也是当场就被录用了。

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen hit it off immediately.
sentences.zh: 凯茜和格温一见如故。

sentences.en: Having recently broken up with her girlfriend, Gwen was looking for a place to stay and jumped at the chance to move in with Kathy.
sentences.zh: 由于刚和女友分手，格温正在寻找住处，于是毫不犹豫地抓住了搬去和凯茜同居的机会。

sentences.en: Within a week of Gwen moving in, Kathy had broken up with Dawn and she and Gwen began dating.
sentences.zh: 在格温搬进去不到一周的时间里，凯茜就和道恩分手了，她和格温开始交往。

sentences.en: Alpine Manor's nursing staff were amused at the couple's appearance.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯庄园的护理人员对这对情侣的外表感到十分有趣。

sentences.en: Gwen was athletically built, weighing 140 pounds and was 5 foot 2 with freckles and a ginger mullet.
sentences.zh: 格温身材健美，体重140磅，身高5尺2寸，长着雀斑和一头红色的鲻鱼头。

sentences.en: Kathy was 6 foot tall with a large frame, blue eyes and bleached blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 凯茜身高6尺，体格健壮，有一双蓝眼睛和一头漂白的金发。

sentences.en: The staff joked that the pair completed each other.
sentences.zh: 员工们开玩笑说这两人绝配。

sentences.en: Kathy provided the brains in the relationship, while Gwen provided the brawn.
sentences.zh: 凯茜负责提供这段感情中的大脑，而格温则负责提供体力。

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen bonded over their troubled upbringings.
sentences.zh: 凯茜和格温因为同样坎坷的成长经历而紧密联系在一起。

sentences.en: Kathy's father had been a strict disciplinarian, often resorting to physical violence.
sentences.zh: 凯茜的父亲是个严厉的纪律主义者，经常诉诸肉体暴力。

sentences.en: Her mother took a back seat and left the care of her other children to Kathy, who was responsible for making sure they were looked after.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲则当起了甩手掌柜，把照顾其他孩子的责任甩给了凯茜，由她负责确保弟妹们得到照顾。

sentences.en: Gwen had been the victim of child sexual abuse at the hands of her own father
sentences.zh: 格温曾遭到亲生父亲的儿童性虐待。

sentences.en: She self-harmed in her teens, describing it as a way of freeing herself from the pain of her childhood
sentences.zh: 她在十几岁时开始自残，称这是将自己从童年痛苦中解脱出来的一种方式。

sentences.en: Both Kathy and Gwen knew they were carrying a lot of emotional baggage
sentences.zh: 凯茜和格温都知道自己背负着沉重的精神包袱。

sentences.en: There was also something else they harboured
sentences.zh: 她们心中还藏着别的东西。

sentences.en: Hatred for their elderly parents
sentences.zh: 对年迈父母的憎恨。

sentences.en: Deaths at Alpine Manor were common
sentences.zh: 在阿尔卑斯庄园，死亡是常态。

sentences.en: On average, 5 to 10 residents passed each month from conditions relating to old age.
sentences.zh: 平均每个月都有5到10名居民因年老体衰而离世。

sentences.en: Flu season saw the death toll climb even higher.
sentences.zh: 流感季节更是让死亡人数直线攀升。

sentences.en: It wasn't long after Gwen Graham started that she witnessed her first death, an elderly woman named Helen who died from pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 格温·格雷厄姆开始工作后不久，就目睹了她的第一起死亡事件——一位名叫海伦的老太太死于肺炎。

sentences.en: Gwen appeared devastated at the loss.
sentences.zh: 格温对这场离世显得悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: But after Helen had been transported to the funeral home, the tears stopped.
sentences.zh: 但把海伦运送到殡仪馆后，眼泪就止住了。

sentences.en: Gwen told her colleagues, I couldn't stand Helen.
sentences.zh: 格温对同事们说，我简直受够海伦了。

sentences.en: I couldn't stand that woman.
sentences.zh: 我受够那个女人了。

sentences.en: All she did was whine all the time.
sentences.zh: 她整天就知道唠唠叨叨。

sentences.en: About a month after Gwen started working at Alpine Manor, another new nursing aid was on the night shift when a resident pressed the call button next to their bed.
sentences.zh: 在格温开始在阿尔卑斯庄园工作大约一个月后，另一名新来的护理助理正在上夜班，这时一位居民按下了床头的呼叫铃。

sentences.en: The room was occupied by two residents, so the nursing aide entered quietly and in the dark.
sentences.zh: 这个房间里住着两位居民，因此这名护理助理在黑暗中静悄悄地走了进去。

sentences.en: As she approached the bedside, the aide could see that the resident was sound asleep.
sentences.zh: 当她走近床边时，助理看到那位居民正在熟睡。

sentences.en: As she searched for the call button to see how it had been pressed on its own, the aide felt a tight grip around her ankle.
sentences.zh: 当她寻找呼叫铃想看看它是怎么无缘无故被按响时，助理感到脚踝被死死地抓住了。

sentences.en: She fled the room screaming, waking Alpine Manor's residents.
sentences.zh: 她尖叫着逃出房间，惊醒了阿尔卑斯庄园的居民们。

sentences.en: Moments later, Gwen Graham emerged from underneath the resident's bed, laughing hysterically, while other aides comforted the frightened residents.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，格温·格雷厄姆从那名居民的床底下钻了出来，歇斯底里地大笑，而其他助理则在安慰受惊的居民。

sentences.en: Gwen played practical jokes on her fellow staff almost every night, at the expense of the residents of Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 格温几乎每天晚上都会对同事们恶作剧，而代价则是阿尔卑斯庄园的居民们。

sentences.en: When coming on shift, Gwen would turn their beds around so the bottom of the bed was where the headboard should have been.
sentences.zh: 接班时，格温会把他们的床调个方向，让床尾变成床头该有的位置。

sentences.en: When this got old, she moved residents into different rooms to surprise and confuse nursing aides.
sentences.zh: 当这招玩腻后，她会把居民们调到不同的房间，以此来惊吓和困惑护理助理们。

sentences.en: Gwen pulled all the wire screens from the windows that backed onto the courtyard so she could make a hasty retreat if the charge nurse was coming.
sentences.zh: 格温把所有通往庭院的窗户上的铁丝网都拆了，这样如果护士长来查房，她就能迅速撤退。

sentences.en: She also hid in the courtyard at night to bang on the windows and scare staff.
sentences.zh: 她还会在夜里躲在庭院里敲击窗户来吓唬员工。

sentences.en: It also terrified the residents.
sentences.zh: 这也把居民们吓得魂飞魄散。

sentences.en: Nighthouse supervisor Tish Prescott was sick of the shenanigans.
sentences.zh: 夜班主管蒂什·普雷斯科特对这些胡闹行为已经忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: She knew a lot of the trouble stamped from Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 她知道很多麻烦都源自凯茜·诺德和格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: They used the PA system to gossip about other staff and had residents with speech impediments read announcements just to laugh at them.
sentences.zh: 她们用广播系统八卦其他员工，还让有语言障碍的居民朗读通知，只为了嘲笑他们。

sentences.en: Tish had tried to separate the women, but they swapped shifts with other aides so they could remain working together.
sentences.zh: 蒂什曾试图将这两个女人分开，但她们却和别的助理调班，以便能继续一起工作。

sentences.en: Tish had resorted to sneaking up on the pair to keep her eye on them.
sentences.zh: 蒂什不得不采取潜行的方式来暗中监视她们。

sentences.en: She often found them alone in residence rooMs. Tish had also heard reports of nursing aides sneaking off to spend time together in unoccupied beds.
sentences.zh: 她经常发现她们独自呆在居民的房间里。蒂什还听说有护理助理偷偷溜进空着的病床厮混的传闻。

sentences.en: Rumours circulated that Gwen Graham had sex with an orderly in one of the residence rooMs. Tish took her concerns about Kathy Wood
sentences.zh: 有传言称格温·格雷厄姆在其中一间居民房里跟一个护工发生了性关系。蒂什将她对凯茜·伍德

sentences.en: and Gwen Graham to the director of nursing, saying, those two are just no good for each other.
sentences.zh: 和格温·格雷厄姆的担忧告诉了护理主任，说道：“这两个人在一起压根就没好事。”

sentences.en: She pleaded for something to be done, explaining that resident care was suffering as a result.
sentences.zh: 她恳求采取行动，并解释说居民的护理质量因此受到了影响。

sentences.en: Upper management declared that they weren't in a position to step in.
sentences.zh: 高层管理人员宣称他们不便介入。

sentences.en: Whatever the staff chose to do on their breaks was out of their control.
sentences.zh: 员工在休息时间选择做什么是他们无法控制的。

sentences.en: One night, Gwen Graham came to work so drunk that she couldn't walk in a straight line.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，格温·格雷厄姆来上班时喝得酩酊大醉，连直线都走不稳。

sentences.en: Tish Prescott sent her home and reported Gwen to management, expecting she would be fired.
sentences.zh: 蒂什·普雷斯科特把她遣送回家，并向管理层举报了格温，本以为她会被开除。

sentences.en: However, Gwen was back on shift the following night.
sentences.zh: 然而，格温第二天晚上又回来上班了。

sentences.en: At 4.30 one morning in December 1986, Nancy Hahn was woken by her telephone ringing.
sentences.zh: 1986年12月的一个早晨4点半，南希·哈恩被一阵电话铃声吵醒。

sentences.en: The caller identified herself as a nurse from Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人自称是阿尔卑斯庄园的一名护士。

sentences.en: She explained that Nancy's mother, Belle Burkhardt, a resident of the facility, had declined quickly in health.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，南希的母亲、疗养院居民贝尔·伯克哈特健康状况急剧恶化。

sentences.en: Belle wasn't expected to make it through the day.
sentences.zh: 贝尔恐怕挺不过今天了。

sentences.en: Nancy lived three hours drive away from Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 南希开车到阿尔卑斯庄园需要三个小时。

sentences.en: She couldn't afford to miss work that day, so after a long, anxious shift, she raced to her ailing mother.
sentences.zh: 她那天实在请不起假，所以在结束了漫长而焦虑的班次后，她火速赶去看望生病的母亲。

sentences.en: She hoped and prayed that she'd still be alive to say her goodbyes.
sentences.zh: 她只希望并祈祷母亲还活着，能让她做最后的道别。

sentences.en: Nancy arrived at Alpine Manor and rushed to Belle's room.
sentences.zh: 南希抵达阿尔卑斯庄园，急匆匆地冲进贝尔的房间。

sentences.en: Her bed was empty.
sentences.zh: 她的床是空的。

sentences.en: Nancy inquired at the nursing station.
sentences.zh: 南希去护士站询问。

sentences.en: None of the nurses knew where Belle Burkhardt was.
sentences.zh: 没有一个护士知道贝尔·伯克哈特在哪里。

sentences.en: They appeared bemused when Nancy told them she had received a phone call in the early hours from a nurse telling her that her mother was about to pass away.
sentences.zh: 当南希告诉她们自己在清晨接到一个护士的电话，说她母亲快要不行了的时候，她们显得有些莫名其妙。

sentences.en: Belle Burkhard was discovered sitting at a dining room table, alive and like her normal self.
sentences.zh: 人们发现贝尔·伯克哈特正安然无恙、和平常一样坐在餐厅的桌子旁。

sentences.en: Nancy fed her dinner and then stopped to talk to the charge nurse who checked the record.
sentences.zh: 南希喂她吃完晚饭，然后停下来和负责核对记录的护士长交谈。

sentences.en: Nobody had logged a call to Nancy.
sentences.zh: 根本没有人登记过给南希打过电话。

sentences.en: Furthermore, there were no staff notes indicating concerns for her mother's health.
sentences.zh: 此外，也没有任何员工记录表明对她母亲的健康状况感到担忧。

sentences.en: It became clear that Nancy had been the victim of a cruel hoax call from the night shift.
sentences.zh: 很显然，南希成了夜班恶作剧电话的受害者。

sentences.en: The charge nurse checked who had been working that shift.
sentences.zh: 护士长查阅了当晚是谁值班。

sentences.en: One name stood out.
sentences.zh: 有一个名字格外显眼。

sentences.en: Kathy Wood.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德。

sentences.en: At the end of 1986, an anonymous complaint was made to the Michigan Health Department regarding the level of care at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 1986年底，一封匿名投诉信寄到了密歇根州卫生部门，内容关于阿尔卑斯庄园护理之家的护理水平。

sentences.en: There were reports of residents sitting in soiled incontinence aids for hours and only being bathed once a week.
sentences.zh: 据报告称，院内老人有时坐着用脏了的失禁护理垫长达数小时，且一周只能洗一次澡。

sentences.en: Staff turnover was cited as the main reason for the lack of care.
sentences.zh: 人手更替频繁被认为是缺乏照料的主要原因。

sentences.en: 112 nurses' aides had been hired during that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年，疗养院共雇用了112名护工。

sentences.en: By October,
sentences.zh: 截至10月，

sentences.en: 71 had left.
sentences.zh: 已有71人离职。

sentences.en: To quell public concern, Alpine Manor was subject to an unannounced visit from a health inspector.
sentences.zh: 为了平息公众的担忧，卫生检查员对阿尔卑斯庄园进行了突击检查。

sentences.en: A lot had changed in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，这里发生了很大变化。

sentences.en: One staff member described Alpine Manor as having an eerie atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 一名员工形容阿尔卑斯庄园有一种诡异的氛围。

sentences.en: Residents were treated like children.
sentences.zh: 住养老人被当成小孩子对待。

sentences.en: Staff spoke to them in childlike voices and styled the female residents' long hair into pigtails.
sentences.zh: 工作人员用幼稚的语调跟他们说话，还把女性老人的长发扎成双马尾。

sentences.en: The craft room now only contained children's colouring books and a few crayons.
sentences.zh: 活动室里现在只有儿童填色书和几支蜡笔。

sentences.en: Cartoon pictures and drawings were taped to the walls.
sentences.zh: 墙上贴满了卡通图片和涂鸦。

sentences.en: Residents reliant on wheelchairs were pushed together with nothing to keep them occupied.
sentences.zh: 靠轮椅代步的老人被推挤在一起，没有任何东西让他们打发时间。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a local radio station blasted over the PA system to drown out the screams from residents with dementia.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，当地一家广播电台通过广播系统大声播放音乐，以盖过失智老人的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Following the visit from the health inspector, a report was issued.
sentences.zh: 卫生检查员视察后，发布了一份报告。

sentences.en: It found that Alpine Manor was safely practising within state guidelines.
sentences.zh: 报告认定阿尔卑斯庄园的运营符合州政府的各项安全规程。

sentences.en: No further follow-up was needed.
sentences.zh: 无需采取进一步的跟进措施。

sentences.en: Despite the ongoing issues caused during their employment, both Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham continued to receive praise from upper management.
sentences.zh: 尽管在职期间不断制造问题，凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆仍然不断受到高层管理人员的表扬。

sentences.en: They regarded the women as extremely hard workers.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这两个女人工作极其刻苦。

sentences.en: Both often pulled double shifts to make up for understaffing.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补人手不足，两人经常连上两个班。

sentences.en: On a competency test issued by the state health department, Gwen scored a 97% mark.
sentences.zh: 在州卫生部门举行的胜任能力测试中，格温考了97分。

sentences.en: On her test sheet, the examiner wrote the word great on every page and drew a big smiley face.
sentences.zh: 在她的试卷上，考官在每一页都写下了“棒”字，并画了一个巨大的笑脸。

sentences.en: They were particularly impressed with Gwen's use of washcloths.
sentences.zh: 他们对格温使用毛巾的方法印象尤为深刻。

sentences.en: On her exam paper, Gwen wrote that she rolled them up into log shapes and put them in the palms of residents' clenched hands to stop their fingernails from digging into their skin.
sentences.zh: 格温在考卷上写道，她把毛巾卷成圆木状，放在老人紧握的手掌里，以防他们的指甲掐进皮肤里。

sentences.en: She always carried washcloths with her and could be seen with at least one flapping from the back pocket of her pants at all times.
sentences.zh: 她总是随身携带毛巾，随时都能看到至少有一条毛巾从她裤子的后口袋里露出来。

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen had a tight friendship circle of fellow nursing aides, but there were a few staff members who saw through their charade.
sentences.zh: 凯茜和格温在其他护工中有一个紧密的朋友圈，但也有少数员工看穿了她们的假面具。

sentences.en: They regarded Kathy and Gwen as bullies and liars who ruled through intimidation.
sentences.zh: 他们认为凯茜和格温是恶霸和骗子，靠恐吓来发号施令。

sentences.en: Kathy once complained about a fellow aide she didn't like to a superior, saying that the aide wasn't changing incontinence aides overnight.
sentences.zh: 凯茜曾向主管抱怨过一个她不喜欢的同行护工，称该护工夜里不给老人更换失禁护理垫。

sentences.en: The charge nurse accompanied Kathy and found a resident lying in a puddle of urine.
sentences.zh: 护士长跟着凯茜前去查看，发现一名老人正躺在一泊尿液中。

sentences.en: Later, it transpired that Kathy had asked Gwen to pour cups of water over the resident's legs to make them soaking wet.
sentences.zh: 后来，据透露，是凯茜让格温把几杯水倒在老人的腿上，好让衣服湿透。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Forever and Five Days by Lowell Caulfield, Gwen later said,
sentences.zh: 正如洛厄尔·考尔菲尔德在《永远与五天》一书中所详述的那样，格温后来回忆说：

sentences.en: Everybody was scared of Kathy.
sentences.zh: 所有人都怕凯茜。

sentences.en: Kathy would fuck with you.
sentences.zh: 凯茜会整你。

sentences.en: That was just her thing, and everybody knew it.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的作风，所有人心里都清楚。

sentences.en: It kinda made me feel good because she was my girl And as long as she was my girl, nobody was going to fuck with me
sentences.zh: 这让我感觉挺好的，因为她是我的好姐妹，只要她是我的好姐妹，就没人敢整我。

sentences.en: One morning, a nursing aide was working with Kathy to dress a particularly difficult resident
sentences.zh: 一天早上，一名护工正和凯茜一起帮一位特别难照料的老人穿衣服。

sentences.en: All day he screamed and yelled
sentences.zh: 他整天大喊大叫，

sentences.en: Yet whenever he saw Kathy Wood, he quietened straight away
sentences.zh: 然而每当他看到凯茜·伍德时，立刻就安静了下来。

sentences.en: Nurses had previously joked about Kathy's ability to silence the man On this occasion, the nursing aide asked Cathy how she managed to quiet him.
sentences.zh: 护士们以前曾开玩笑说起过凯茜让那名男子安静下来的能力，这一次，这名护工问凯茜她是怎么做到这一点的。

sentences.en: Just watch, Cathy said.
sentences.zh: “看着就行，”凯茜说。

sentences.en: She proceeded to whisper something into the man's ear.
sentences.zh: 接着，她在那个男人的耳边低语了一些话。

sentences.en: Within seconds, he became fearful and silent.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟之内，他变得惊恐万状，噤若寒蝉。

sentences.en: The aide asked Cathy what she had said.
sentences.zh: 护工问凯茜她说了什么。

sentences.en: With a smile, she replied,
sentences.zh: 她微笑着回答：

sentences.en: I said, go ahead.
sentences.zh: “我说，有本事，

sentences.en: Scream one more time.
sentences.zh: 再叫一声试试。

sentences.en: But look at me.
sentences.zh: 但你看仔细了，

sentences.en: I'm bigger than you.
sentences.zh: 我比你高大，

sentences.en: I'm huge, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我庞大得多。

sentences.en: You are helpless.
sentences.zh: 你毫无反抗之力，

sentences.en: I am not.
sentences.zh: 而我不是。

sentences.en: You scream one more time and I will kill you.
sentences.zh: 你再叫一声，我就杀了你。

sentences.en: And there will be nothing you can do to stop me.
sentences.zh: 而且你无能为力，阻止不了我。”

sentences.en: The aide considered reporting Kathy Wood's remark to management, but she was too frightened of the fallout from Kathy and Gwen and chose to keep it to herself.
sentences.zh: 这名护工曾考虑向管理层举报凯茜·伍德的这番话，但她太害怕凯茜和格温的报复了，最终选择把这件事烂在肚子里。

sentences.en: Nights later, a nursing aide named La Donna was working the night shift when she answered the call button of 87-year-old Clara Pierce.
sentences.zh: 几天后，一个名叫拉多娜的夜班护工在值班时，按下了87岁老人克拉拉·皮尔斯的呼叫铃。

sentences.en: Clara had been at Alpine Manor for six years and suffered from dementia.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉已经在阿尔卑斯庄园住了六年，患有失智症。

sentences.en: She was still quite lucid and could hold conversations with the staff.
sentences.zh: 她当时头脑还算清醒，能够与工作人员进行交流。

sentences.en: As soon as LaDonna entered her room, Clara screamed,
sentences.zh: 拉多娜刚一走进房间，克拉拉就尖叫道：

sentences.en: They're gonna kill me.
sentences.zh: “他们要杀了我。

sentences.en: They whisper to me that they are going to kill me.
sentences.zh: 他们在耳边对我说他们要杀了我。”

sentences.en: Clara had recently been found wandering the halls at night, so the doctor had ordered that her wrists be tied to the bed while she was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉最近被发现夜里在走廊里游荡，因此医生下令在她睡觉时将她的手腕绑在床上。

sentences.en: LaDonna released Clara and escorted her to the bathroom and back to bed.
sentences.zh: 拉多娜解开克拉拉的束缚，扶她去洗手间，然后送回床上。

sentences.en: As LaDonna reapplied Clara's restraints, she begged not to be tied up, yelling,
sentences.zh: 当拉多娜重新给克拉拉绑上约束带时，她哀求不要把自己绑起来，大喊道：

sentences.en: You don't understand.
sentences.zh: “你们不明白，

sentences.en: They're coming to kill me.
sentences.zh: 他们要来杀我了。”

sentences.en: LaDonna reassured Clara that no one was coming to kill her.
sentences.zh: 拉多娜安慰克拉拉说没有人会来杀她。

sentences.en: LaDonna turned off the light and left Clara alone, strapped to her bed.
sentences.zh: 拉多娜关灯离开了，留下了被绑在床上的克拉拉独自一人。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持Casefile继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: On Christmas Day 1986, Ed Chambers drove to Alpine Manor to visit his wife, Marguerite.
sentences.zh: 1986年圣诞节当天，埃德·钱伯斯开车来到阿尔卑斯庄园探望他的妻子玛格丽特。

sentences.en: He was joined by his daughter, Jan, who had some warm clothing to give her ailing mother.
sentences.zh: 随行的还有他的女儿让，她带了一些厚衣服送给生病的母亲。

sentences.en: Marguerite's room in Alpine Manor always seemed to be cold, and Marguerite often kicked off her bedsheets with her rocking movements.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特在阿尔卑斯庄园的房间似乎总是很冷，而且由于身体不停摇晃，她经常把床单踢开。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at Alpine Manor, Jan noticed the dried food caked around her mother's mouth, indicating that she hadn't been cleaned since her last meal.
sentences.zh: 一到阿尔卑斯庄园，让就发现母亲嘴边结了一层干涸的食物残渣，这表明她自上一顿饭以来一直没有被清理过。

sentences.en: Jan found a washcloth and dampened it.
sentences.zh: 让找了一条毛巾并把它弄湿。

sentences.en: When she went to wipe her mother's face with it, Marguerite jumped.
sentences.zh: 当她走过去用湿毛巾擦拭母亲的脸时，玛格丽特吓得跳了起来。

sentences.en: She turned her head from side to side, refusing to have her mouth cleaned.
sentences.zh: 她把头转来转去，拒绝清洗口腔。

sentences.en: Marguerite's Alzheimer's prevented her from speaking, so Jan couldn't ask her what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特患有阿尔茨海默病，无法开口说话，因此让无法询问她究竟哪里不舒服。

sentences.en: But when she looked into her mother's eyes, she saw something she would never forget.
sentences.zh: 但当她凝视着母亲的眼睛时，她看到了她永远也不会忘记的东西。

sentences.en: Absolute terror.
sentences.zh: 绝对的恐惧。

sentences.en: During the week prior, Marguerite Chambers had been looked after by two nurses more than any others.
sentences.zh: 在此之前的一周里，照顾玛格丽特·钱伯斯最多的两名护士是：

sentences.en: Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: Post-Christmas, Marguerite was not herself.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节过后，玛格丽特判若两人。

sentences.en: She was feverish and appeared to have gone downhill physically.
sentences.zh: 她发着高烧，身体状况似乎也急转直下。

sentences.en: Nobody could pinpoint why.
sentences.zh: 没有人能找出具体原因。

sentences.en: A little under a month later, on Sunday January 18, 1987, Ed Chambers returned to Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月后，即1987年1月18日星期日，埃德·钱伯斯再次来到阿尔卑斯庄园。

sentences.en: Marguerite made rocking movements in bed as Ed held her hand and talked to her for an hour.
sentences.zh: 埃德握着玛格丽特的手跟她聊了一个小时，期间她一直在床上摇晃身体。

sentences.en: At 8pm, he said goodnight and left.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点，他道了晚安便离开了。

sentences.en: 30 minutes later, a nursing aide found Marguerite Chambers unresponsive in bed.
sentences.zh: 30分钟后，一名护工发现玛格丽特·钱伯斯躺在床上毫无反应。

sentences.en: Efforts to revive her failed and Marguerite was pronounced dead.
sentences.zh: 抢救无效，玛格丽特被宣告死亡。

sentences.en: She was 60 years old.
sentences.zh: 享年60岁。

sentences.en: One by one, nursing staff went into Marguerite's room to pay their respects.
sentences.zh: 护理人员一个接一个地走进玛格丽特的房间，向她致以最后的敬意。

sentences.en: Among them were Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 其中包括凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: As per protocol following a death at Alpine Manor, the charge nurse phoned to the facility's on-call doctor.
sentences.zh: 按照阿尔卑斯庄园发生死亡事件后的标准程序，护士长打电话给疗养院的待命医生。

sentences.en: It was a Sunday night and he didn't want to drive through the heavy snow to examine Marguerite's body in person.
sentences.zh: 当时是周日晚上，他不愿冒着大雪开车亲自来检查玛格丽特的遗体。

sentences.en: Instead, he ordered her to be transferred to the mortuary over the phone.
sentences.zh: 相反，他在电话里下令将遗体直接转运至太平间。

sentences.en: The following day, the doctor signed Marguerite's death certificate without having seen her body.
sentences.zh: 第二天，这名医生在连遗体面都没见过的情况下，就签署了玛格丽特的死亡证明。

sentences.en: Under the cause of death, he wrote, heart attack.
sentences.zh: 他在死因一栏写下了：心脏病发作。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, on the morning of Tuesday February 3, a registered nurse began her shift at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 三周后的2月3日星期二早晨，一名注册护士开始在阿尔卑斯庄园值班。

sentences.en: She soon noticed that a 95-year-old resident named Myrtle Luce had blood dripping from her nose.
sentences.zh: 她很快注意到，一位名叫默特尔·露斯的95岁老人鼻子里正流着血。

sentences.en: The nurse applied a compress and made a note of the incident but didn't think any more about it.
sentences.zh: 护士给她进行了冷敷并记录了这一事件，但并没有把这当回事。

sentences.en: A series of strokes and organic brain syndrome had robbed Myrtle of her normal functions.
sentences.zh: 一连串的中风和器质性脑综合征剥夺了默特尔正常的身体机能。

sentences.en: Although she was somewhat aware of what was going on around her, she could no longer walk or talk.
sentences.zh: 尽管她对周围发生的事情还有一些意识，但她已经无法行走或说话了。

sentences.en: Myrtle spent the majority of her time curled up in bed in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 默特尔大部分时间都像胎儿一样蜷缩在床上。

sentences.en: The only time Myrtle seemed to know what was going on around her was when her son came to visit.
sentences.zh: 默特尔唯一能表现出对周围环境有所感知的时候，就是她儿子来探望她的时候。

sentences.en: When she saw him, Myrtle changed instantly.
sentences.zh: 一见到儿子，默特尔就判若两人。

sentences.en: She smiled and patted his face.
sentences.zh: 她会微笑着轻拍他的脸。

sentences.en: Because of her high care needs, Cathy Wood openly complained to her colleagues that she didn't like Myrtle Loose.
sentences.zh: 由于护理需求极高，凯茜·伍德公开向同事抱怨她不喜欢默特尔·露斯。

sentences.en: She found her too difficult to take care of.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这个病人太难照顾了。

sentences.en: A week after Myrtle was treated for her unexplained bloody nose, a nurse aide found her deceased in bed.
sentences.zh: 在默特尔因不明原因流鼻血接受治疗一周后，一名护工发现她在床上去世了。

sentences.en: This time, her nose was covered in mucus and looked bruised.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她的鼻子覆满了黏液，并且看起来有瘀伤。

sentences.en: On the mattress beside Myrtle's body was a rolled up washcloth.
sentences.zh: 在默特尔遗体旁边的床垫上，放着一条卷起来的毛巾。

sentences.en: Myrtle's body was sent directly to the mortuary by the Alpine Manor doctor without examination, as in the case of
sentences.zh: 和玛格丽特·钱伯斯的情况一样，阿尔卑斯庄园的医生未经检查，便直接将默特尔的遗体送往了太平间。

sentences.en: Marguerite Chambers.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·钱伯斯。

sentences.en: And like that incident, the doctor listed Myrtle's cause of death as heart attack.
sentences.zh: 和那次事件一样，医生将默特尔的死因归结为心脏病发作。

sentences.en: Myrtle's loved ones were surprised by the news of her sudden death.
sentences.zh: 默特尔的亲人们对她突然离世的消息感到十分震惊。

sentences.en: She had undergone a physical exam just days earlier, during which the doctor had described her heart health as impeccable.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前她刚接受过体检，当时医生还形容她的心脏健康状况无可挑剔。

sentences.en: Following Myrtle's funeral, her family penned a card to the Alpine Manor staff to thank them for the care and compassion they had shown Myrtle while she was alive.
sentences.zh: 默特尔的葬礼结束后，她的家人给阿尔卑斯庄园的员工写了一张卡片，感谢他们在默特尔生前给予她的关怀和同情。

sentences.en: It was pinned to the staff bulletin board.
sentences.zh: 这张卡片被钉在员工公告栏上。

sentences.en: Days later, Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham invited Kathy's ex-girlfriend Dawn over to their place.
sentences.zh: 几天后，凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆邀请凯茜的前女友道恩到她们家做客。

sentences.en: As they sat in the living room drinking, Gwen casually mentioned that she had been responsible for Myrtle's death.
sentences.zh: 当她们坐在起居室里喝酒时，格温随口提到是她害死了默特尔。

sentences.en: Gwen asked Dawn if she wanted to see proof.
sentences.zh: 格温问道恩想不想看证据。

sentences.en: Dawn followed Gwen and Kathy into the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 道恩跟着格温和凯茜走进了卧室。

sentences.en: On a shelf lay a single sock.
sentences.zh: 架子上放着一只单只袜子。

sentences.en: This belonged to her, Gwen said
sentences.zh: “这属于她，”格温说。

sentences.en: Dawn was well aware of the twisted pranks and mind games the couple often played She passed off the comment as a sick joke
sentences.zh: 道恩对这对情侣经常玩的变态恶作剧和心理游戏心知肚明，她把这话当成了一个恶劣的玩笑。

sentences.en: Kathy was known to steal from the residents of Alpine Manor
sentences.zh: 众所周知，凯茜有偷窃阿尔卑斯庄园住养老人物品的习惯。

sentences.en: Once taking a resident's rosary beads to hang from the rearview mirror of her truck
sentences.zh: 她曾经拿过一位老人的念珠，挂在她卡车的后视镜上。

sentences.en: The more Dawn thought about it, the more she believed that the pair had just stolen a sock or that it belonged to Kathy.
sentences.zh: 道恩越想越觉得，这两人要么只是偷了一只袜子，要么就是凯茜自己的。

sentences.en: Dawn told herself,
sentences.zh: 道恩心里想：

sentences.en: Gwen's just fucking with me.
sentences.zh: “格温这死丫头又在耍我呢。”

sentences.en: On the morning of Monday, February 16, 1987, an Alpine Manor nursing aide named Sean peered into the room of 79-year-old resident May Mason.
sentences.zh: 1987年2月16日星期一早晨，阿尔卑斯庄园的一名护工肖恩探头查看79岁老人梅·梅森的房间。

sentences.en: May, who had Alzheimer's disease, was awake.
sentences.zh: 患有阿尔茨海默病的梅当时醒着。

sentences.en: She fidgeted with her hands in bed and seemed agitated.
sentences.zh: 她在床上不停地搓着双手，显得有些烦躁。

sentences.en: Sean took a damp washcloth to freshen May, wiping it over her face and hands.
sentences.zh: 肖恩拿了一条湿毛巾帮梅清理，擦拭了她的脸和双手。

sentences.en: But this only heightened May's distress.
sentences.zh: 但这反而加剧了梅的痛苦。

sentences.en: She kept clutching at the washcloth, not wanting it to touch her skin.
sentences.zh: 她一直死死抓住毛巾，不希望它碰到自己的皮肤。

sentences.en: Sean tried to calm May, but had to check on other residents.
sentences.zh: 肖恩试图安抚梅，但她还得去查看其他老人。

sentences.en: She rolled May from her side onto her back and tucked her in, pulling the covers to her neck.
sentences.zh: 她把梅从侧卧位翻成仰卧位，帮她掖好被子，把被子拉到她的脖子处。

sentences.en: When she left, May was wide awake.
sentences.zh: 她离开时，梅正睁大着眼睛。

sentences.en: Two hours later, Sean checked on May again.
sentences.zh: 两个小时后，肖恩再次去查看梅的情况。

sentences.en: Her skin had turned grey and her fingernails were now blue.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤已经变成灰色，指甲也发青了。

sentences.en: Her pulse was imperceptible and she was pronounced deceased at 4am.
sentences.zh: 已经摸不到脉搏，她在凌晨4点被宣告死亡。

sentences.en: Sean was devastated and sought support from her colleagues.
sentences.zh: 肖恩悲痛欲绝，向同事寻求安慰。

sentences.en: Fellow aide Gwen Graham did her best to comfort her.
sentences.zh: 同为护工的格温·格雷厄姆竭尽全力安慰她。

sentences.en: Mae Mason's cause of death was listed as cardiac arrest by her family physician.
sentences.zh: 家庭医师将梅·梅森的死因列为心搏骤停。

sentences.en: Her death came six days after Myrtle Luce.
sentences.zh: 她的死发生在默特尔·露斯去世六天后。

sentences.en: The next day, 74-year-old Alpine Manor resident Belle Burkhard was found to have bruising to her face, particularly around her nose and right cheek.
sentences.zh: 第二天，74岁的阿尔卑斯庄园住养老人贝莉·伯克哈德被发现面部有瘀伤，尤其是鼻子和右脸颊周围。

sentences.en: The injuries were reported to management.
sentences.zh: 这些伤情被上报给了管理层。

sentences.en: As Belle often suffered from seizures, they put the injuries down to an unwitnessed seizure during the night.
sentences.zh: 由于贝尔经常癫痫发作，他们将这些伤归咎于当晚无人目击的癫痫发作。

sentences.en: It was assumed she must have hit her head on the bed's metal railings.
sentences.zh: 人们认为她一定是撞到了床的金属护栏上。

sentences.en: The nurse assigned to Belle that night was Kathy Wood.
sentences.zh: 当晚分配给贝尔的护士是凯西·伍德。

sentences.en: She was never questioned about it and it wasn't investigated further.
sentences.zh: 她从未因此受到盘问，也没有进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: Kathy often complained to other staff about Belle Burkhardt's high-care needs.
sentences.zh: 凯西经常向其他员工抱怨贝尔·伯克哈特的护理需求很高。

sentences.en: She didn't like Belle.
sentences.zh: 她不喜欢贝尔。

sentences.en: The feeling was mutual.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉是相互的。

sentences.en: Belle made it difficult for Kathy to turn her, often gripping onto bed bars.
sentences.zh: 贝尔让凯西很难为她翻身，经常紧紧抓住床栏。

sentences.en: Whenever Kathy tried to verbally intimidate her, Belle would just laugh in her face.
sentences.zh: 每当凯西试图在言语上吓唬她时，贝尔只会当面嘲笑她。

sentences.en: At 3am on Thursday February 26, Kathy volunteered to supervise the nurse's station while the other staff went on break.
sentences.zh: 2月26日星期四凌晨3点，凯西自愿在护士站值班，而其他员工则去休息。

sentences.en: Belle Burkhardt was found deceased a few hours later.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，贝尔·伯克哈特被发现已经死亡。

sentences.en: The nursing aide who found her noticed that Belle's arm was positioned at an odd angle underneath her body.
sentences.zh: 发现她的护理助理注意到贝尔的一只手臂以奇怪的姿势夹在身体下方。

sentences.en: When Belle's body was bathed for the funeral home, the aide noticed that the same arm was badly bruised.
sentences.zh: 当为殡仪馆清洗贝尔的遗体时，助理注意到同一只手臂有严重的淤青。

sentences.en: Nobody knew why.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道为什么。

sentences.en: One of Cathie Wood's nursing friends suggested that the bruising might have been caused from the nursing aide not turning Belle during the night.
sentences.zh: 凯西·伍德的一位护士朋友暗示，淤青可能是因为护理助理夜间没有为贝尔翻身造成的。

sentences.en: The matter was dismissed.
sentences.zh: 这件事不了了之。

sentences.en: Belle was released to the mortuary without a doctor viewing her body.
sentences.zh: 贝尔在没有医生查看遗体的情况下被送往停尸房。

sentences.en: The cause of death was listed as a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 死因被列为心脏病发作。

sentences.en: Like Myrtle Luce's family, Belle Burkhardt's couldn't believe what had happened.
sentences.zh: 就像默特尔·露斯的家人一样，贝尔·伯克哈特的家人无法相信发生的一切。

sentences.en: During a check-up a week prior, the doctor had mentioned her heart was fine.
sentences.zh: 在一周前的体检中，医生曾提到她的心脏很健康。

sentences.en: As the number of sudden deaths in Alpine Manor grew, Kathy Wood, Gwen Graham and their Alpine Manor cohorts became increasingly out of control.
sentences.zh: 随着阿尔派庄园突发死亡人数的增加，凯西·伍德、格温·格雷厄姆以及她们在阿尔派庄园的同伙越来越失控。

sentences.en: The couple would host wild parties at their home on their days off, during which staff in attendance would run down the street topless.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣会在休息日在家里举办疯狂的派对，期间参加的员工会光着上身在街上奔跑。

sentences.en: For no discernible reason, the disorderly group would get into physical fights with each other at pubs and clubs, resulting in serious injuries.
sentences.zh: 毫无明显理由，这群举止混乱的人会在酒吧和俱乐部互相发生肢体冲突，导致严重受伤。

sentences.en: Nursing aide LaDonna had two of her teeth knocked out during one inexplicable altercation.
sentences.zh: 护理助理拉多娜在一次莫名其妙的争执中被打掉了两颗牙齿。

sentences.en: In the book, Forever and Five Days, LaDonna said,
sentences.zh: 拉多娜在书《永远与五天》中说道，

sentences.en: We had all gone crazy.
sentences.zh: 我们都疯了。

sentences.en: We didn't care for each other's feelings.
sentences.zh: 我们不在乎彼此的感受。

sentences.en: We didn't have any feelings.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何感觉。

sentences.en: One day, in April 1987, a nursing aide named Catherine snuck through the back door of Alpine
sentences.zh: 1987年4的一天，一名叫凯瑟琳的护理助理偷偷穿过阿尔派

sentences.en: Manor and into the director of nursing's office.
sentences.zh: 庄园的后门，进入了护理主任的办公室。

sentences.en: With a black eye, her arm in a sling, and a cracked rib, Catherine didn't want to be seen by her colleagues as she asked for time off.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳顶着黑眼圈、手臂吊着绷带、肋骨骨裂，不希望被同事看到，她来请求休假。

sentences.en: Initially brushing off her injuries as the result of an accident, the truth was soon uncovered.
sentences.zh: 起初把她的伤势轻描淡写地归咎于一场意外，但真相很快就被揭开了。

sentences.en: Cathy Wood had lured Catherine to a deserted area on the outskirts of Grand Rapids with the pretense of hooking up.
sentences.zh: 凯西·伍德以约会为借口，将凯瑟琳引诱到大急湍市郊区的一个荒凉地区。

sentences.en: Other nursing aides were also there, watching in amusement as Gwen
sentences.zh: 其他护理助理也在场，津津有味地看着格温

sentences.en: Graham confronted Catherine.
sentences.zh: 与凯瑟琳对质。

sentences.en: She knocked her to the ground, then punched and kicked her repeatedly in the chest and stomach.
sentences.zh: 她将她撞倒在地，然后反复拳打脚踢她的胸部和腹部。

sentences.en: Gwen was called into the office and asked if the story was true.
sentences.zh: 格温被叫进办公室，并被问及这个故事是否属实。

sentences.en: Smiling, Gwen explained, I wouldn't do something like that.
sentences.zh: 格温微笑着解释道，我不会做出那种事。

sentences.en: She left the office and faced no repercussions.
sentences.zh: 她离开办公室，没有受到任何惩罚。

sentences.en: The incident had staff terrified of Kathy and Gwen, with many refusing to work with them
sentences.zh: 这起事件让员工们对凯西和格温感到恐惧，许多人拒绝与她们共事。

sentences.en: Reports continued to flood management about the pair's toxic behaviour
sentences.zh: 关于这两人有毒行为的举报不断涌入管理层。

sentences.en: Yet, when given a report about Kathy's bullying, the Alpine Manor manager ripped it up and threw it in the bin She was friends with Kathy and didn't want her to get into trouble
sentences.zh: 然而，当收到关于凯西霸凌行为的举报时，阿尔派庄园经理将其撕碎并扔进了垃圾桶。她是凯西的朋友，不想让凯西惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Instead, the manager decided to separate Kathy from the aides that were making the allegations against her
sentences.zh: 相反，经理决定将凯西与指控她的助理们隔离开来。

sentences.en: Kathy was called into the manager's office and was given the good news She had been promoted
sentences.zh: 凯西被叫进经理办公室，并得到了好消息。她升职了。

sentences.en: She was now in charge of nursing aides on her shift
sentences.zh: 她现在负责她那班的护理助理。

sentences.zh: 案卷档案稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 凯西·伍德的许多工作朋友对她的晋升感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But there was one who wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但有一个人并不高兴。

sentences.en: Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: She believed she worked harder than
sentences.zh: 她认为自己比
