sentences.zh: 凯西工作更努力，她才应该是升职的那个人。

sentences.en: It made things difficult at home.
sentences.zh: 这让家里的情况变得艰难。

sentences.en: Cathie and
sentences.zh: 凯西和

sentences.en: Gwen argued often, with the fights often culminating in violence.
sentences.zh: 格温经常争吵，争吵往往以暴力告终。

sentences.en: The walls of their house were damaged with holes as a result of punches thrown in fits of anger.
sentences.zh: 由于情绪失控时的挥拳，他们家的墙壁上布满了破洞。

sentences.en: When Kathy learned Gwen had sex with another nursing aide, she became furious, yelling so loudly that her screams were heard from down the street.
sentences.zh: 当凯西得知格温与另一名护理助理发生性关系时，她勃然大怒，尖叫声大到在街那头都能听到。

sentences.en: When Gwen tried to leave the house, Kathy dragged her back in by her hair and slapped her repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 当格温试图离开房子时，凯西抓住她的头发把她拖了回来，并多次扇她耳光。

sentences.en: She was often seen at work covered in scratches and bruises.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到她在工作时浑身是抓痕和淤青。

sentences.en: By mid-1987, Gwen had had enough.
sentences.zh: 到1987年中期，格温已经忍够了。

sentences.en: She moved out of Kathy's home and into a trailer.
sentences.zh: 她搬出了凯西的家，住进了一辆拖车里。

sentences.en: Joining Gwen was her new girlfriend, a 21-year-old nursing aide from Alpine Manor named Heather
sentences.zh: 加入格温的是她的新女友，一个来自阿尔派庄园的21岁护理助理，名叫海瑟

sentences.en: Barrager.
sentences.zh: 巴拉格尔。

sentences.en: Heather, who had never been in a relationship before, told Gwen she was madly in love with her.
sentences.zh: 海瑟以前从未谈过恋爱，她告诉格温她疯狂地爱着她。

sentences.en: Together, they hatched a plan.
sentences.zh: 两人密谋了一个计划。

sentences.en: They would leave Grand Rapids and return to Gwen's hometown in Texas to start over.
sentences.zh: 他们将离开大急湍，回到格温位于得克萨斯的家乡重新开始。

sentences.en: Kathy found out and visited Gwen, demanding she return home.
sentences.zh: 凯西发现了此事并前去拜访格温，要求她回家。

sentences.en: After an argument, Gwen agreed.
sentences.zh: 争吵过后，格温同意了。

sentences.en: Kathy took her to the bedroom where they had sex.
sentences.zh: 凯西带她去了卧室并发生了性关系。

sentences.en: As detailed in Forever and Five Days, as Gwen lay on the bed,
sentences.zh: 正如《永远与五天》中所详细描述的那样，当格温躺在床上时，

sentences.en: Kathy retrieved some restraints she had taken from Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 凯西拿出了她从阿尔派庄园拿走的束缚带。

sentences.en: She tied Gwen's wrists to the bed.
sentences.zh: 她把格温的手腕绑在了床上。

sentences.en: Then, she walked to the foot of the bed.
sentences.zh: 然后，她走到床尾。

sentences.en: In her hands was a loaded gun that belonged to Gwen.
sentences.zh: 她手里拿着一把属于格温的上膛手枪。

sentences.en: Kathy inserted the gun barrel into Gwen's body, threatening,
sentences.zh: 凯西将枪管塞进格温的身体里，威胁道，

sentences.en: I'll kill you.
sentences.zh: 我要杀了你。

sentences.en: Kathy left Gwen tied up for three hours When she returned, Kathy removed the gun and untied her
sentences.zh: 凯西把格温绑着留下了三个小时。当她回来时，凯西拿走了枪并解开了她的绳子。

sentences.en: After a discussion, Kathy agreed it was over between them
sentences.zh: 经过一番讨论，凯西同意他们之间彻底结束了。

sentences.en: Gwen returned to her girlfriend Heather She asked why Gwen dropped everything to please Kathy
sentences.zh: 格温回到了她的女友海瑟身边。她问为什么格温要为取悦凯西而放弃一切。

sentences.en: Gwen responded
sentences.zh: 格温回应道，

sentences.en: Kathy has something over me
sentences.zh: 凯西手里有我的把柄。

sentences.en: Gwen and Heather decided now was the time to act.
sentences.zh: 格温和海瑟决定现在是采取行动的时候了。

sentences.en: In August 1987, they packed their belongings into Gwen's car and fled for Texas.
sentences.zh: 1987年8月，她们把行李装进格温的车里，逃往得克萨斯。

sentences.en: With nowhere else to turn, Kathy Wood returned to her ex-husband, Ken.
sentences.zh: 走投无路之下，凯西·伍德回到了前夫肯身边。

sentences.en: She told him she and Gwen had done things she was afraid of.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她和格温做了一些让她感到害怕的事情。

sentences.en: She wanted to tell Ken, but he had to promise her first that he would keep it secret.
sentences.zh: 她想告诉肯，但他必须先答应她会保守秘密。

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 它。

sentences.en: He gave her his word.
sentences.zh: 他向她许下了承诺。

sentences.en: After a moment's silence, Cathy said to him, what's the worst thing you could think of to do to someone?
sentences.zh: 沉默片刻后，凯茜对他说，你能想到的对别人做过的最糟糕的事情是什么？

sentences.en: Ken replied, murder would be the worSt. Thinking there was no way Cathy would murder someone, he was completely taken aback when she replied, well, try six times.
sentences.zh: 肯回答说，谋杀将是最糟糕的。他本以为凯茜绝对不可能谋杀任何人，当她回答说，好吧，试着六次时，他完全惊呆了。

sentences.en: Kathy told Ken about one of the residents they had killed, 97-year-old Edith Cook.
sentences.zh: 凯西向肯讲述了他们谋杀的一位居民，97岁的埃迪丝·库克。

sentences.en: Edith was one of the most popular residents among staff and other residents at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 埃迪丝是阿尔派庄园的员工和其他居民中最受欢迎的居民之一。

sentences.en: She had been there for six years, once telling a social worker that Alpine Manor is grand, everything is all very lovely.
sentences.zh: 她已经在那里呆了六年，曾对社工说阿尔派庄园很宏伟，一切都非常可爱。

sentences.en: She spent her days visiting and chatting to other residents.
sentences.zh: 她每天都在探望其他居民并与他们聊天。

sentences.en: But in the months before her death, Edith's health deteriorated rapidly.
sentences.zh: 但在她去世前的几个月里，埃迪丝的健康状况急剧恶化。

sentences.en: One night, she was found with her legs poking through the metal bars on her bed.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，人们发现她的双腿从床的金属栏杆中伸出来。

sentences.en: Pressure sores developed which turned into painful gangrene.
sentences.zh: 她长出了压疮，并最终转化为痛苦的坏疽。

sentences.en: Edith's condition was deemed to be palliative, meaning that she would not survive.
sentences.zh: 埃迪丝的病情被认为是姑息治疗阶段，这意味着她无法存活。

sentences.en: At 2.30 on the morning of Thursday, April 7, 1987, Edith Cook was found deceased in her bed.
sentences.zh: 1987年4月7日星期四凌晨2点30分，埃迪丝·库克被发现死在床上。

sentences.en: The night nurse assigned to her care was Kathy Wood.
sentences.zh: 分配照顾她的夜班护士是凯西·伍德。

sentences.en: Also working on the wing that night was Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 当晚在该病区工作的还有格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: In an effort to understand what his ex-wife had just confessed, Ken asked if Kathy and Gwen killed people to end their pain and suffering.
sentences.zh: 为了理解前妻刚刚的坦白，肯问凯西和格温是否为了结束痛苦和折磨而杀人。

sentences.en: Kathy replied, no, we did it for fun.
sentences.zh: 凯西回答说，不，我们是为了好玩而杀人。

sentences.en: Kathy went on to detail her experiences.
sentences.zh: 凯西接着详细讲述了她的经历。

sentences.en: The idea to murder residents at Alpine Manor arose one day as she and Gwen sat at their dining table doing the morning crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 一天，她和格温坐在餐桌旁做早间填字游戏时，萌生了谋杀阿尔派庄园居民的想法。

sentences.en: Work had been getting boring and the pair had always wondered what it would be like to kill.
sentences.zh: 工作变得越来越无聊，两人一直想知道杀人是什么感觉。

sentences.en: They chose 60-year-old Marguerite Chambers to be their first victim.
sentences.zh: 她们选择60岁的玛格丽特·钱伯斯作为她们的第一个受害者。

sentences.en: On the night of Sunday January 18 1987, after Marguerite's husband left for the night, Cathy said she and Gwen approached her room.
sentences.zh: 在1987年1月18日星期日的晚上，玛格丽特的丈夫离开后，凯茜说她和格温走近了她的房门。

sentences.en: Keeping watch by the door, Cathy made sure the coast was clear as Gwen slipped inside.
sentences.zh: 凯茜在门边放哨，确保四周无人，而格温则溜了进去。

sentences.en: She held two washcloths rolled into log shapes.
sentences.zh: 她手里拿着两条卷成圆木形状的毛巾。

sentences.en: Kathy claimed that Gwen took one washcloth and positioned it under Marguerite's chin to support her jaw.
sentences.zh: 凯西声称，格温拿了一条毛巾放在玛格丽特的下巴下方以支撑她的下巴。

sentences.en: She placed the other washcloth over Marguerite's nose.
sentences.zh: 她把另一条毛巾放在玛格丽特的鼻子上。

sentences.en: Then she squeezed hard.
sentences.zh: 然后她用力挤压。

sentences.en: Marguerite thrashed in bed trying to free herself, but Gwen easily overpowered the ailing woman.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特在床上挣扎着想要脱身，但格温轻易地制服了这个病弱的女人。

sentences.en: Marguerite then went limp.
sentences.zh: 随后玛格丽特瘫软下来。

sentences.en: Gwen slipped out without drawing attention from anyone else and walked back to her assigned wing.
sentences.zh: 格温悄悄溜走，没有引起任何其他人的注意，并走回了她分配的病区。

sentences.en: Both she and Kathy were tending to other residents when Marguerite was found deceased less than 30 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 不到30分钟后，当玛格丽特被发现死亡时，她和凯西正在照顾其他居民。

sentences.en: This was not the first time Kathy and Gwen had tried to kill Marguerite.
sentences.zh: 这并不是凯西和格温第一次尝试杀死玛格丽特。

sentences.en: They had attempted the same method a month prior.
sentences.zh: 她们一个月前就尝试过相同的方法。

sentences.en: Kathy explained that it had all gone to plan.
sentences.zh: 凯西解释说，一切都按计划进行。

sentences.en: They waited for the nursing aide assigned to
sentences.zh: 她们等着分配给

sentences.en: Marguerite's care to find her dead.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特护理工作的助理发现她死亡。

sentences.en: But Gwen had only rendered Marguerite unconscious.
sentences.zh: 但格温只是让玛格丽特失去了知觉。

sentences.en: From this failed experience, Gwen learned she needed to suffocate her victim for a few minutes after they stopped moving.
sentences.zh: 从这次失败的经验中，格温吸取了教训，她需要在受害者停止移动后继续将其窒息几分钟。

sentences.en: This attempted murder explained why Marguerite Chambers had been so terrified of having her face cleaned with a washcloth.
sentences.zh: 这次未遂谋杀解释了为什么玛格丽特·钱伯斯如此害怕用毛巾清洁面孔。

sentences.en: Cathy gave a strange explanation as to why they targeted Marguerite Chambers firSt. At Alpine Manor, there was a logbook.
sentences.zh: 凯茜对她们为何将玛格丽特·钱伯斯作为第一个目标给出了奇怪的解释。在阿尔派庄园，有一本日志。

sentences.en: Every time a resident passed away, their name was entered into the book with one entry per line.
sentences.zh: 每次有居民去世，他们的名字都会被登记在该书的一行中。

sentences.en: Marguerite started with the letter M.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的名字以字母M开头。

sentences.en: If they could find another five residents to kill with the initials they were looking for, then running down the page, they could spell out the word murder.
sentences.zh: 如果她们能找到另外五个首字母符合她们寻找的目标的居民来杀死，那么顺着页面往下看，她们就能拼出“谋杀”（murder）这个单词。

sentences.en: But their plan was too hard.
sentences.zh: 但她们的计划太难了。

sentences.en: The residents they needed to make the murder acronym were active and lucid.
sentences.zh: 她们需要用来拼写谋杀缩写的居民都很有活力且意识清醒。

sentences.en: Instead, the couple chose victims who were non-verbal or suffering advanced dementia.
sentences.zh: 相反，这对情侣选择了无法说话或患有晚期痴呆症的受害者。

sentences.en: That way, if they survived the suffocation, they would not be able to tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，如果他们在窒息中幸存下来，也将无法告诉任何人。

sentences.en: Even if they did, no one would believe them.
sentences.zh: 即使他们说了，也没有人会相信他们。

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen pinched residents' noses while they lay in bed to see how they would react to having their air supply cut off suddenly.
sentences.zh: 凯西和格温在居民躺在床上时捏住他们的鼻子，看看他们对气源突然被切断会有什么反应。

sentences.en: If one put up too much of a fight, the pair moved on to someone else.
sentences.zh: 如果有人反抗得太厉害，两人就会转向其他人。

sentences.en: This was why some residents were found with unexplained bruising or bloody noses.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么有些居民被发现有无法解释的淤青或流鼻血。

sentences.en: When it was time to carry out the killings, Gwen used washcloths to prevent any bruising that could raise suspicion.
sentences.zh: 当到了实施杀戮的时候，格温使用毛巾来防止任何可能引起怀疑的淤青。

sentences.en: According to Kathy, Gwen said she felt more relaxed after killing someone, saying it helped to ease her tension.
sentences.zh: 据凯西说，格温曾说她在杀人后感觉更加轻松，并表示这有助于缓解她的紧张情绪。

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen believed that sharing the secret of the murders would bind them together forever.
sentences.zh: 凯西和格温相信，分享谋杀的秘密将把她们永远绑在一起。

sentences.en: Ken struggled with what to do with the information
sentences.zh: 肯一直在纠结该如何处理

sentences.en: Kathy had given him.
sentences.zh: 凯西提供给他的信息。

sentences.en: He wanted to believe it was a fabricated story, but he didn't want to dismiss it entirely.
sentences.zh: 他希望相信这是一个虚构的故事，但他又不想完全忽视它。

sentences.en: Over a year passed as Ken agonised over what to do.
sentences.zh: 一年多过去了，肯一直在痛苦地思考该怎么办。

sentences.en: During this time, he kept Kathy's confession to himself as she continued to work at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他将凯西的坦白深埋心底，而凯西则继续在阿尔派庄园工作。

sentences.en: On Thursday, October 6, 1988,
sentences.zh: 1988年10月6日星期四，

sentences.en: Ken was driving past the police station when he made a last-minute decision.
sentences.zh: 肯开车路过警察局时，临时做出了一个决定。

sentences.en: He went inside to report Cathy's allegations.
sentences.zh: 他进去汇报了凯茜的指控。

sentences.en: When asked why he had waited so long to come forward, Ken explained, I didn't want to destroy my life and I didn't want to destroy her life
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么等了这么久才站出来时，肯解释说：“我不想毁了自己的生活，我也不想毁了她的生活”，

sentences.en: by turning her in, but I felt I should find out if Kathy was dangerous.
sentences.zh: “通过把她交出去，但我觉得我应该弄清楚凯茜是否危险。”

sentences.en: I know she can hate with the best of them.
sentences.zh: “我知道她恨起人来绝不含糊。”

sentences.en: The following day, Kathy Wood was at work when a detective arrived at Alpine
sentences.zh: 第二天，凯茜·伍德正在上班，一名侦探来到了高山

sentences.en: Manor.
sentences.zh: 庄园。

sentences.en: He found Kathy wandering the hall and told her he was taking her in for questioning.
sentences.zh: 他发现凯茜在走廊里徘徊，并告诉她要带她去接受审讯。

sentences.en: Kathy didn't act surprised or ask why.
sentences.zh: 凯茜没有表现出惊讶，也没有问为什么。

sentences.en: She grabbed her coat and accompanied the detective in silence.
sentences.zh: 她抓起外套，默默地陪着侦探走了。

sentences.en: Kathy agreed to be interviewed.
sentences.zh: 凯茜同意接受讯问。

sentences.en: When told that her ex-husband had implicated her and Gwen Graham in the murder of an Alpine Manor resident, Kathy threw her head back and laughed.
sentences.zh: 当得知她的前夫指控她和格温·格雷厄姆谋杀了一名高山庄园的居民时，凯茜把头往后仰，大笑起来。

sentences.en: The detective told her he didn't think it was very funny, prompting Kathy to sober up.
sentences.zh: 侦探告诉她，他觉得这一点也不好笑，这让凯茜清醒了过来。

sentences.en: Kathy was an open book to detectives.
sentences.zh: 在侦探面前，凯茜就像一本翻开的书。

sentences.en: Although she'd told Ken there were six victims, she told police of five – Marguerite Chambers, May Mason, Belle Burkhardt, Edith Cook and Myrtle
sentences.zh: 尽管她曾告诉肯有六名受害者，但她告诉警方有五名——玛格丽特·钱伯斯、梅·梅森、贝尔·伯克哈特、伊迪丝·库克和默特尔

sentences.en: Luce.
sentences.zh: 露丝。

sentences.en: There might have been another three that Gwen killed, but Cathy maintained that she couldn't remember the details or wasn't at work when they were killed.
sentences.zh: 可能还有格温杀害另外三人的情况，但凯茜坚称她记不清细节，或者在她们被杀时她不在上班。

sentences.en: She described planning the crime spree as, quote, almost exciting in a way.
sentences.zh: 她将策划这一系列罪行的过程描述为，引述，“某种程度上几乎令人兴奋”。

sentences.en: Cathy recalled the night Gwen murdered 79-year-old
sentences.zh: 凯茜回忆起格温谋杀79岁老人的那个夜晚

sentences.en: Mae Mason.
sentences.zh: 梅·梅森。

sentences.en: Gwen approached Kathy and told her she was going to do Mae.
sentences.zh: 格温走近凯茜，告诉她她要对梅下手了。

sentences.en: Kathy warned her it was not the right time.
sentences.zh: 凯茜警告她现在不是好时机。

sentences.en: There were two nurses nearby and Kathy was assigned to a different wing.
sentences.zh: 附近有两个护士，而凯茜被分派到了另一个病区。

sentences.en: But they came up with a plan.
sentences.zh: 但他们想出了一个计划。

sentences.en: Kathy distracted the nurses with gossip while Gwen slipped into
sentences.zh: 凯茜用闲聊分散护士的注意力，而格温则溜进了

sentences.en: Mae's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 梅的卧室。

sentences.en: They were very nearly discovered when Gwen killed Belle Burkhardt.
sentences.zh: 当格温杀死贝尔·伯克哈特时，他们差点被发现。

sentences.en: That morning,
sentences.zh: 那天早上，

sentences.en: Kathy had volunteered to supervise the nurse's station while the other staff went on a break.
sentences.zh: 趁其他员工休息时，凯茜自愿留下来监督护士站。

sentences.en: As she sat alone, Gwen approached from the wing she was assigned to.
sentences.zh: 当她独自坐在那里时，格温从她被指派的病区走了过来。

sentences.en: In her back pocket were two washcloths.
sentences.zh: 她的后口袋里装着两块毛巾。

sentences.en: Kathy described how Gwen went into Belle Burkhardt's room while Kathy kept an eye out front from the nurse's station.
sentences.zh: 凯茜描述了格温是如何进入贝尔·伯克哈特的房间的，而凯茜则在护士站留意前方的动静。

sentences.en: An intercom ran from Belle's room to the station.
sentences.zh: 贝尔的房间和护士站之间通着一个内部对讲机。

sentences.en: Kathy could hear a rustle of sheets and then groaning noises
sentences.zh: 凯茜能听到床单的沙沙声，然后是呻吟声

sentences.en: For a few minutes, gurgling noises sounded over the intercom and then stopped
sentences.zh: 对讲机里传了几分钟的咕噜声，然后停了下来

sentences.en: Moments later, Gwen appeared from the room
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，格温从房间里走了出来

sentences.en: Belle was discovered deceased by a nursing aide a few hours later with her arm positioned at an odd angle underneath her body and severe bruising to the skin
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，一名护理助理发现贝尔已经死亡，她的手臂以奇怪的角度放在身体下方，皮肤有严重淤青

sentences.en: According to Kathy, Gwen said that Belle had put up a tremendous fight.
sentences.zh: 据凯茜说，格温说贝尔进行了激烈的反抗。

sentences.en: The bruising on her arm had been caused by Gwen kneeling on it to keep her still.
sentences.zh: 她手臂上的淤青是格温跪在上面压制她造成的。

sentences.en: During her police interview, Kathy was asked what would motivate Gwen to murder.
sentences.zh: 在接受警方讯问时，凯茜被问及是什么促使格温行凶杀人。

sentences.en: She replied,
sentences.zh: 她回答说，

sentences.en: Gwen liked pain and painful things.
sentences.zh: 格温喜欢痛苦和痛苦的事情。

sentences.en: She had a lot of pain in her life.
sentences.zh: 她的人生中经历了很多痛苦。

sentences.en: I don't know if she wanted other people to feel the same.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她是否希望其他人也有同样的感受。

sentences.en: Kathy said her role in the murders ended because she grew tired of it and didn't want to be a lookout anymore.
sentences.zh: 凯茜说她在谋杀案中扮演的角色结束了，因为她对此感到厌倦，不想再担任放风的人了。

sentences.en: She never told Gwen to stop because she wanted her to be happy.
sentences.zh: 她从未叫格温停手，因为她希望她能快乐。

sentences.en: Still, no further killings took place.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，没有再发生更多的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The women had originally planned to take it in turns to kill, but Kathy said she could never bring herself to be the murderer.
sentences.zh: 这两个女人最初计划轮流杀人，但凯茜说她自己怎么也下不了手去当杀手。

sentences.en: She explained,
sentences.zh: 她解释说，

sentences.en: Those people in there were like family to me, and I couldn't do that to them.
sentences.zh: 里面的人对我就像家人一样，我不能对他们做出这种事。

sentences.en: Kathy asserted that Gwen had kept a memento of every victim.
sentences.zh: 凯茜坚称格温保留了每个受害者的纪念品。

sentences.en: From Myrtle Luce she took a sock, from Belle Burkhardt she took a jewellery, from Edith Cook an earring, and from May Mason a keyring trinket.
sentences.zh: 从默特尔·露丝那里她拿了一只袜子，从贝尔·伯克哈特那里她拿了一件首饰，从伊迪丝·库克那里拿了一只耳环，从梅·梅森那里拿了一个钥匙扣饰品。

sentences.en: From Marguerite Chambers she took a balloon given to her with a bunch of flowers from her children.
sentences.zh: 从玛格丽特·钱伯斯那里，她拿了一个气球，那是她孩子们送给她的花束里的一只。

sentences.en: Gwen kept them in a shoebox in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 格温把它们放在浴室的一个鞋盒里。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但出了个问题。

sentences.en: Kathy explained that when Gwen moved out, she had thrown the box away.
sentences.zh: 凯茜解释说，当格温搬走时，她把那个盒子扔掉了。

sentences.en: Police raided the Alpine Manor files pertaining to resident deaths at the time Kathy Wood and Gwen Graham worked together.
sentences.zh: 警方突击搜查了高山庄园中与凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆共事期间居民死亡相关的档案。

sentences.en: Upper management showed little concern about the murder investigation.
sentences.zh: 高层管理人员对谋杀调查表现出漠不关心。

sentences.en: Alpine Manor had just received a glowing review from the government body that certified the nursing home for Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 高山庄园刚刚收到认证该疗养院符合医疗补助资格的政府机构的高度评价。

sentences.en: During their search, detectives uncovered a letter Kathy had written.
sentences.zh: 在搜查过程中，侦探们发现了一封凯茜写的信。

sentences.en: It read in part,
sentences.zh: 信中部分内容写道：

sentences.en: I love you, Gwen.
sentences.zh: 我爱你，格温。

sentences.en: I think you're great.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你太棒了。

sentences.en: For this afternoon, I cannot wait.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，我迫不及待。

sentences.en: That's when we'll wake up and that's when I'll kiss you.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们醒来的时候，也是我会亲吻你的时候。

sentences.en: That's when I'll hold you.
sentences.zh: 那就是我会拥抱你的时候。

sentences.en: Oh Gwen, I miss you.
sentences.zh: 哦，格温，我想你。

sentences.en: Bunny hop over here and let me lick you on the ear.
sentences.zh: 像小兔子一样跳过来，让我舔舔你的耳朵。

sentences.en: Oh please say you'll be mine.
sentences.zh: 哦，请答应做我的伴侣。

sentences.en: Forever and five days.
sentences.zh: 永远再加五天。

sentences.en: Detectives asked Kathy what the last line of her poem meant.
sentences.zh: 侦探问凯茜她诗中的最后一行是什么意思。

sentences.en: She explained that it was their take on the Shakespearean line, forever and a day.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，这是她们对莎士比亚名言“永远和一天”的魔改。

sentences.en: Every time they killed a resident, Kathy and Gwen added an extra day to the saying.
sentences.zh: 每杀害一名居民，凯茜和格温就会在那句话上多加一天。

sentences.en: Six days after Kathy's ex-husband first approached police, officers arrived at Gwen
sentences.zh: 在凯茜的前夫首次接触警方六天后，警官们抵达了格温

sentences.en: Graham's trailer in Texas where she'd started a new life with girlfriend Heather.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆位于得克萨斯州的拖车屋，她正是在那里与女友希瑟开始了新的生活。

sentences.en: With no concrete evidence of murder having been uncovered yet, police arrested Gwen for writing bad checks three years earlier.
sentences.zh: 由于尚未发现谋杀的具体证据，警方以三年前伪造支票为由逮捕了格温。

sentences.en: They hoped that she might open up while sitting in the county jail.
sentences.zh: 他们希望她在县监狱里呆着时能敞开心扉。

sentences.en: Instead, Gwen protested her innocence.
sentences.zh: 然而，格温坚信自己无罪。

sentences.en: She was so certain that she had nothing to do with the deaths at Alpine Manor that she offered to take a polygraph teSt. The operator told the lead
sentences.zh: 她坚信自己与高山庄园的死亡事件无关，以至于她主动提出接受测谎仪测试。操作员告诉负责此案的主任

sentences.en: detective on the case that in his mind, Gwen was a cold-blooded killer.
sentences.zh: 侦探认为，在他看来，格温是个冷血杀手。

sentences.en: But the results of the test were inconclusive.
sentences.zh: 但测试结果没有定论。

sentences.en: Gwen Graham was free to go.
sentences.zh: 格温·格雷厄姆获释了。

sentences.en: She went back to her new job as a nursing aide for a Texas hospital.
sentences.zh: 她回到了她的新工作岗位，在一家得克萨斯州的医院担任护理助理。

sentences.en: Kathy Wood also took a polygraph teSt. As one of her first baseline questions, Kathy was asked what the best thing that ever happened to her was.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德也接受了测谎仪测试。作为她的首要基线问题之一，凯茜被问到她经历过的最好的事情是什么。

sentences.en: She replied that it was her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她回答说是她的女儿。

sentences.en: Then she changed her mind and said Gwen.
sentences.zh: 然后她改变了主意，说是格温。

sentences.en: As for the worst thing,
sentences.zh: 至于最糟糕的事情，

sentences.en: Kathy immediately said that it was when Gwen left her.
sentences.zh: 凯茜脱口而出，那是格温离开她的时候。

sentences.en: She was then asked,
sentences.zh: 接着她被问到，

sentences.en: are you lying about Gwen to get her in trouble?
sentences.zh: 你是不是为了陷害格温而对她撒谎？

sentences.en: After two hours, the polygraph examiner was left with little doubt that Kathy was trying to manipulate the teSt. She was, quote, playing a subtle, intelligent game.
sentences.zh: 两个小时后，测谎仪检查员几乎毫不怀疑凯茜在试图操纵测试。引述，她正在“玩一场微妙、聪明的游戏”。

sentences.en: He believed that Gwen Graham hadn't killed anyone.
sentences.zh: 他相信格温·格雷厄姆没有杀任何人。

sentences.en: It was all a ploy mastered by Kathy, the ultimate revenge for Gwen leaving her.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是凯茜精心策划的诡计，是对格温离开她的终极报复。

sentences.en: In a follow-up polygraph test,
sentences.zh: 在随后的测谎复试中，

sentences.en: Kathy was asked why someone would make up a story like this.
sentences.zh: 凯茜被问及为什么会有人编造这样的故事。

sentences.en: She replied,
sentences.zh: 她回答说，

sentences.en: They'd have to be awfully unhappy, awfully lonely.
sentences.zh: 那他一定极其不幸，极其孤独。

sentences.en: Maybe they even want to go to prison like I do because then they won't have to worry about anything.
sentences.zh: 也许他们甚至像我一样想进监狱，因为那样他们就不用担心任何事情了。

sentences.en: As the Alpine Manor murders investigation reached its sixth week, an excavator was brought to the Rosedale Memorial Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 随着高山庄园谋杀案调查进入第六周，一台挖掘机被开进了罗丝代尔纪念公墓。

sentences.en: The decision had been made to excavate the remains of Marguerite Chambers and Edith Cook.
sentences.zh: 有关部门已决定挖掘玛格丽特·钱伯斯和伊迪丝·库克的遗骸。

sentences.en: Every other victim listed by Kathy Wood had been cremated.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德列出的其他受害者都已被火化。

sentences.en: Marguerite's husband, Ed, had given the go-ahead.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的丈夫埃德给予了放行同意。

sentences.en: He was haunted by the realisation that she might have been murdered, telling the Associated Press,
sentences.zh: 他一直被她可能被谋杀的现实所困扰，他在接受美联社采访时表示：

sentences.en: I went through Marguerite's death once.
sentences.zh: 我已经经历过一次玛格丽特的离世了。

sentences.en: I don't want to go through it twice.
sentences.zh: 我不想再经历第二次。

sentences.en: Since news of the alleged murder, he had suffered nightmares every night about being suffocated in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 自从传出谋杀传闻以来，他每晚都做噩梦，梦见自己在睡梦中窒息而死。

sentences.en: Water had leaked inside Marguerite's coffin, making an examination of her body difficult due to decomposition.
sentences.zh: 水渗入了玛格丽特的棺材，由于尸体腐烂，给她的尸检工作带来了困难。

sentences.en: Both Marguerite's and Edith's mouths were checked, with the medical examiner hoping to find fibres of washcloths to support Cathy's murder theory.
sentences.zh: 法医检查了玛格丽特和伊迪丝的口腔，希望能找到毛巾的纤维来支持凯茜的谋杀理论。

sentences.en: He also checked the skin on their faces for abrasions and checked their eyelids, looking for pinprick-sized bruises that can indicate suffocation.
sentences.zh: 他还检查了他们面部皮肤的擦伤，并检查了眼睑，寻找可能表明窒息的针尖大小的淤青。

sentences.en: No fibres or signs of suffocation were found.
sentences.zh: 没有发现纤维或窒息的迹象。

sentences.en: Cathy claimed that when Gwen killed Edith Cook, she said she had made a mistake by suffocating her with her false teeth still in.
sentences.zh: 凯茜声称，当格温杀死伊迪丝·库克时，她说自己犯了个错误，因为她在伊迪丝还戴着假牙的情况下将其闷死。

sentences.en: If true, the examination would show abrasions to Edith's mouth, indicating that she had bitten down while being suffocated.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，检查会显示伊迪丝嘴部有擦伤，表明她在窒息时曾咬紧牙关。

sentences.en: They weren't there.
sentences.zh: 但并没有这些痕迹。

sentences.en: Marguerite and Edith's cause of death were listed as heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特和伊迪丝的死因被列为心脏病发作。

sentences.en: When the pathologist examined their hearts, he was certain of one thing.
sentences.zh: 当病理学家检查他们的心脏时，他确信了一件事。

sentences.en: Their hearts were in good condition and they had not died from a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 他们的心脏状况良好，并非死于心脏病发作。

sentences.en: Based on these findings and the circumstantial evidence provided by Kathy Wood, the medical examiner changed their cause of death from heart attack to homicide.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现以及凯茜·伍德提供的间接证据，法医将他们的死因从心脏病发作更改为了他杀。

sentences.en: On Sunday December
sentences.zh: 12月星期日

sentences.en: 4 1988, detectives surrounded Gwen Graham's home in Texas with an arrest warrant in hand.
sentences.zh: 1988年4日，侦探手持逮捕令包围了格温·格雷厄姆在得克萨斯州的家。

sentences.en: The lights were on inside, but knocks to the front door went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 里面亮着灯，但敲前门却无人应答。

sentences.en: The trailer park manager revealed that Gwen and her girlfriend had fled weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 拖车公园经理透露，格温和她的女友几周前就逃跑了。

sentences.en: He had no idea where they went.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道她们去了哪里。

sentences.en: Detectives returned to their vehicles, and as they pulled up to an intersection, a Mustang drove by.
sentences.zh: 侦探们返回车里，当他们把车开到十字路口时，一辆野马轿车驶了过去。

sentences.en: Behind the wheel was Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 开车的人正是格温·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: him.
sentences.zh: 他。

sentences.en: She was swiftly arrested without incident and held on a million dollar bond.
sentences.zh: 她很快被顺利逮捕，并以一百万美元保释金被收押。

sentences.en: Kathy Wood was arrested a few hours later.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，凯茜·伍德也被捕了。

sentences.en: Al Van Dyke was sitting at home when he received a telephone call on behalf of Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·范戴克正坐在家里，突然接到一个代表高山庄园打来的电话。

sentences.en: Reading from a pre-written statement, the caller explained that the purpose of his call was to notify Al that his mother, Ruth Van Dyke, was a possible
sentences.zh: 打电话的人宣读了一份事先写好的声明，解释说他打电话的目的是通知阿尔，他的母亲露丝·范戴克可能是

sentences.en: victim in a series of alleged homicides that happened at the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 疗养院发生的一系列谋杀案中的潜在受害者。

sentences.en: Al couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 阿尔简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: He was a former homicide detective himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己以前就是一名凶杀案侦探。

sentences.en: Another call went to Donald Urbanski, the nephew and legal guardian of 90-year-old Wanda.
sentences.zh: 另一个电话打给了唐纳德·乌尔班斯基，他是90岁老人旺达的侄子和法定监护人。

sentences.en: Having been told that Wanda had died from pneumonia,
sentences.zh: 在被告知旺达死于肺炎后，

sentences.en: Donald said the realisation that his aunt could have been murdered hit him like a bolt of lightning.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德说，意识到他的姑姑可能被谋杀，这犹如晴天霹雳击中了她。

sentences.en: He thought back to her last months in Alpine Manor and something began to make sense.
sentences.zh: 他回想起她生前在高山庄园最后的几个月，有些事情开始变得说得通了。

sentences.en: Staff were regularly contacting him to advise that Wanda had sustained bruising, abrasions and lacerations.
sentences.zh: 员工经常联系他，告知旺达身上出现了淤青、擦伤和撕裂伤。

sentences.en: He had always wondered why.
sentences.zh: 他一直纳闷为什么会这样。

sentences.en: Wanda couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 旺达根本动弹不得。

sentences.en: The representative from Alpine Manor made another five calls that day.
sentences.zh: 高山庄园的代表那天还打了另外五个电话。

sentences.en: In total, Kathy had named eight residents in her interviews with detectives that she believed had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 总共算下来，凯茜在接受侦探讯问时点名了八名她认为被谋杀了的居民。

sentences.en: However, Belle Burkhardt's daughter, Nancy Hahn, found out from a journalist who called at her home.
sentences.zh: 然而，贝尔·伯克哈特的女儿南希·哈恩是从一位上门拜访的记者那里得知这一消息的。

sentences.en: When she rang Alpine Manor the following morning to find out why she hadn't been notified, the manager replied,
sentences.zh: 当她第二天早上打电话给高山庄园，询问为什么没有通知她时，经理回答说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, it was an oversight.
sentences.zh: “很抱歉，这是一个疏忽。”

sentences.en: In January 1988, the Michigan Health Department conducted its own investigation.
sentences.zh: 1988年1月，密歇根州卫生部展开了自身的调查。

sentences.en: It found that Alpine Manor management had acted appropriately and had no reason to suspect that there was any elder abuse going on at the time of the murders.
sentences.zh: 调查发现，高山庄园管理层行事得当，在谋杀发生时没有理由怀疑存在任何虐待老人的行为。

sentences.en: As news of the homicides broke, nursing staff were ordered not to speak to the press.
sentences.zh: 随着谋杀案消息的传开，护理人员被命令不得接受媒体采访。

sentences.en: One manager did tell reporters,
sentences.zh: 其中一位经理确实对记者说过：

sentences.en: Kathy Wood's reviews were great You couldn't ask for anyone more professional
sentences.zh: “凯茜·伍德的评价非常棒，你找不到比她更专业的人了”

sentences.en: Kathy was very popular She was a favourite
sentences.zh: “凯茜非常受欢迎，她是个大红人”

sentences.en: Prosecutors faced a problem
sentences.zh: 检察官面临着一个难题

sentences.en: There was only enough evidence to charge Gwen Graham With the murders of Marguerite Chambers and Edith Cook
sentences.zh: 现有的证据只够起诉格温·格雷厄姆涉嫌谋杀玛格丽特·钱伯斯和伊迪丝·库克

sentences.en: The two women whose bodies were exhumed
sentences.zh: 也就是尸体被开棺验尸的两名女性

sentences.en: Even then, the case relied heavily on Kathy Wood's testimony
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这起案件在很大程度上仍依赖于凯茜·伍德的证词

sentences.en: Without her cooperation the case would fall apart.
sentences.zh: 如果没有她的配合，案件将会瓦解

sentences.en: Because of this, the prosecution offered Kathy a plea deal in exchange for her testimony at trial.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，控方与凯茜达成了一项认罪协议，以换取她在庭审中的证词

sentences.en: If Kathy pleaded guilty to second-degree murder and one count of conspiracy to commit murder, she would be given a more lenient jail sentence with the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 如果凯茜对二级谋杀罪和一项串谋谋杀罪认罪，她将获得较轻的刑期，并有机会获得假释

sentences.en: Kathy agreed, and with that, further charges were brought against
sentences.zh: 凯茜表示同意，随后，当局对

sentences.en: Gwen.
sentences.zh: 格温提出了进一步的指控

sentences.en: She was now charged with conspiracy to commit murder and the first-degree murder of five residents from Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 她现在被控串谋谋杀以及一级谋杀阿尔派庄园的五名居民

sentences.en: Gwen's defence team were almost certain she would be acquitted.
sentences.zh: 格温的辩护团队几乎确信她会被判无罪

sentences.en: There were no washcloth fibres or fingerprints linking their client to the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 没有任何毛巾纤维或指纹将他们的当事人与受害者联系起来

sentences.en: None of the mementos that Cathy claimed Gwen had taken as souvenirs had been found.
sentences.zh: 凯茜声称格温作为纪念品拿走的那些纪念物一件也没有找到

sentences.en: The only link to Gwen was Kathy's word, who they said had a motive for lying.
sentences.zh: 唯一与格温有关联的证据就是凯茜的一面之词，他们称凯茜有说谎的动机

sentences.en: They alleged that the entire story was concocted by Kathy to get back at Gwen for leaving her.
sentences.zh: 他们指称，整个故事都是凯茜为了报复格温抛弃她而捏造的

sentences.en: It was an allegation supported by many of Gwen's friends and co-workers, who couldn't believe for a second that Gwen was guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 这一指控得到了格温的许多朋友和同事的支持，他们怎么也不相信格温会犯下谋杀罪

sentences.en: Yet, Gwen and Kathy had confessed their involvement in murdering Alpine Manor residents to at least three other nursing aides and to Kathy's sister.
sentences.zh: 然而，格温和凯茜曾向至少另外三名护理助理以及凯茜的妹妹坦白过他们参与谋杀阿尔派庄园居民的事情

sentences.en: None of them believed they were being serious.
sentences.zh: 他们当中没有人相信这是真的

sentences.en: The trial began in September 1989.
sentences.zh: 审判于1989年9月开始

sentences.en: In his opening statements, the assistant prosecutor warned the jury that
sentences.zh: 在开案陈词中，副检察官警告陪审团说

sentences.en: This is a bizarre case and it was committed by bizarre people.
sentences.zh: 这是一起离奇的案件，而且是由离奇的人犯下的

sentences.en: Kathy testified against Gwen for two full days.
sentences.zh: 凯茜针对格温出庭作证了整整两天

sentences.en: Appearing tearful and softly spoken, she detailed how she stood lookout while Gwen suffocated the victims of Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 她泪眼汪汪、轻声细语地详细讲述了自己如何在格温窒息阿尔派庄园受害者时放风

sentences.en: She appeared to the jury that she herself was a victim of Gwen's, testifying that she was the one who had been tied to their bed with a gun inserted in her vagina.
sentences.zh: 她在陪审团面前表现得仿佛她自己也是格温的受害者，作证称正是自己被绑在他们的床上，阴道里还被塞了一把枪

sentences.en: The prosecution had one final witness to call.
sentences.zh: 控方还有最后一位证人要传唤

sentences.en: It was Gwen's girlfriend, Heather, who confirmed that she and Gwen were no longer a couple.
sentences.zh: 那就是格温的女友希瑟，她证实她和格温已经不再是情侣了

sentences.en: Heather told the courtroom about the day police had first come to the trailer to search.
sentences.zh: 希瑟向法庭讲述了警察第一次来到拖车屋搜查的那天

sentences.en: After they visited, Heather asked if she had murdered residents of Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 他们离开后，希瑟问格温是否谋杀了阿尔派庄园的居民

sentences.en: Gwen replied, yes.
sentences.zh: 格温回答，是的

sentences.en: Not wanting to believe it, Heather replied, no you didn't.
sentences.zh: 希瑟不愿相信这一切，回答说，不，你没有

sentences.en: Heather showed the jury how Gwen had shaken her by the shoulders, saying, I know you don't want to believe it, but I did it.
sentences.zh: 希瑟向陪审团展示了格温是如何抓着她的肩膀摇晃并说道，我知道你不想相信，但我确实这么做了

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我真的做了

sentences.en: As Heather stepped down from the witness box and was escorted away, Gwen shouted,
sentences.zh: 正当希瑟走下证人席并被护送离开时，格温大喊道

sentences.en: I still love you, Heather.
sentences.zh: 希瑟，我依然爱你

sentences.en: The jury deliberated for six hours.
sentences.zh: 陪审团商议了六个小时

sentences.en: For the first degree murder of five victims and the charge of conspiracy to commit murder,
sentences.zh: 因谋杀五名受害者的谋杀罪以及串谋谋杀罪

sentences.en: Gwen Graham was found guilty.
sentences.zh: 格温·格雷厄姆被判有罪

sentences.en: Gwen showed no emotion as the verdicts were read.
sentences.zh: 宣读判决时，格温面无表情

sentences.en: She was sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 她被判处终身监禁，不得假释

sentences.en: Families of the victims crowded the steps outside the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 受害者家属挤满了法庭外的台阶

sentences.en: They were collectively happy with the verdict, although Marguerite Chambers' husband, Ed, told reporters he wished Michigan still had the death penalty in place.
sentences.zh: 他们对这一判决总体感到满意，尽管玛格丽特·钱伯斯的丈夫埃德告诉记者，他希望密歇根州仍然保留死刑

sentences.en: His daughter, Jan, said,
sentences.zh: 他的女儿简说

sentences.en: My mother can finally rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 我母亲终于可以安息了

sentences.en: The scars will always be there, but it helps knowing the truth.
sentences.zh: 伤痕将永远存在，但知道真相会有所帮助

sentences.en: One noticeable absence at the trial was Hazel Dredge, the daughter of murdered victim Myrtle Luce.
sentences.zh: 审判中明显缺席的一人是黑泽尔·德雷奇，被害人默特尔·露丝的女儿

sentences.en: Hazel had been a constant presence in Myrtle's life while she was alive.
sentences.zh: 在默特尔生前，黑泽尔一直陪伴在她身边

sentences.en: She visited Alpine Manor almost daily to make sure her mother was being cared for.
sentences.zh: 她几乎每天都去阿尔派庄园，确保母亲得到照顾

sentences.en: But, like her mother, Hazel had succumbed to Alzheimer's disease.
sentences.zh: 但是，和她的母亲一样，黑泽尔也患上了阿尔茨海默病

sentences.en: At the time of the trial, she was a resident at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 在审判期间，她也是阿尔派庄园的住客

sentences.en: Following the trial, Alpine Manor released a statement to the media which read,
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，阿尔派庄园向媒体发表了一份声明，其中写道

sentences.en: Even though we find it difficult to believe that any of this actually happened, our primary goal is to help the well-being of residents and their families.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们很难相信这一切真的发生过，但我们的首要目标是维护居民及其家属的福祉

sentences.en: We will continue to provide quality care in a supportive environment in our nursing home.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续在我们的疗养院内提供支持性环境中的优质护理

sentences.en: In October 1989, Kathy Wood was sentenced.
sentences.zh: 1989年10月，凯茜·伍德被宣判

sentences.en: Her lawyer read from a statement which said,
sentences.zh: 她的律师宣读了一份声明，其中说道

sentences.en: Saying I'm sorry is not enough.
sentences.zh: 说抱歉是远远不够的

sentences.en: Mere words cannot express the remorse or guilt I'll have to live with for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 单纯的言语无法表达我余生都将带着的悔恨或内疚

sentences.en: Before handing down his sentence, the judge remarked,
sentences.zh: 法官在宣判前评论道

sentences.en: I'm most impressed by the fact that if it wasn't for you coming forward I'm sure this matter never would have been cleared up.
sentences.zh: 让我印象最深的是，如果不是你主动站出来，我确信这件事情永远不会水落石出

sentences.en: If I turned you loose today I'm convinced you wouldn't do anything like this again.
sentences.zh: 如果我今天把你放了，我深信你绝不会再做这种事

sentences.en: Kathy Wood was sentenced to 20 to 40 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德被判处20至40年监禁

sentences.en: With good behaviour she would be eligible for parole after serving only 16.
sentences.zh: 表现好的话，她服刑仅仅16年后就有资格获得假释

sentences.en: Many people believed that Kathy was more involved in the murders than simply standing lookout.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，凯茜在谋杀案中扮演的角色远不止放风那么简单

sentences.en: Nursing staff remembered her as a manipulative liar and were convinced that she pulled the wool over everyone's eyes, from detectives on the case to the trial judge.
sentences.zh: 护理人员记得她是一个操纵欲强的骗子，并确信她瞒过了所有人，从案件侦探到审判法官无一幸免

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Forever and Five Days, a hairdresser named
sentences.zh: 正如书籍《永远与五天》中所详细记载的那样，1987年末，一位名叫

sentences.en: Maureen Haverhill was tending to Alpine Manor resident Lucille Vanderveen in late 1987.
sentences.zh: 莫琳·黑弗希尔的美发师正在为阿尔派庄园的居民露西尔·范德芬做头发

sentences.en: Lucille was very distressed and told the hairdresser They tried to kill me last night They tried to smother me in my bed But I fought back I swung and I kicked and I scratched
sentences.zh: 露西尔非常痛苦，并告诉美发师他们昨晚试图杀了我 他们试图在我的床上闷死我 但我进行了反抗 我挥拳、踢腿、又抓又挠

sentences.en: And they couldn't do it
sentences.zh: 他们没能得逞

sentences.en: Maureen assured Lucille that nobody was trying to kill her But after hearing of the Alpine Manor murders She realised that Lucille might have been telling the truth
sentences.zh: 莫琳向露西尔保证没有人想杀她 但在听说阿尔派庄园的谋杀案后 她意识到露西尔可能说的是真的

sentences.en: Yet, it couldn't have been Gwen Graham who attacked Lucille.
sentences.zh: 然而，袭击露西尔的人不可能是格温·格雷厄姆

sentences.en: She had left Alpine Manor five weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 她五周前就已经离开阿尔派庄园了

sentences.en: A former inmate of Cathy Woods said she bragged about the murders in prison, showing other inmates clippings from newspapers about the case.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德的一名狱友称，她在狱中吹嘘这些谋杀案，向其他狱友展示报纸上关于此案的剪报

sentences.en: The inmate said that they were discussing the murders when Cathy allegedly admitted,
sentences.zh: 该狱友称，当时她们正在讨论谋杀案，凯茜据称承认道

sentences.en: I did the murders.
sentences.zh: 人是我杀的

sentences.en: I really got that bitch back.
sentences.zh: 我可算狠狠报复了那个贱人

sentences.en: That's what Gwen gets for breaking up with me.
sentences.zh: 这就是格温甩了我的下场

sentences.en: In September 2018, Kathy Wood came up for parole.
sentences.zh: 2018年9月，凯茜·伍德迎来了假释期

sentences.en: Her application was challenged by family members of the victims of Alpine Manor who filed an appeal.
sentences.zh: 她的申请受到了阿尔派庄园受害者家属的反对，他们提交了上诉

sentences.en: They believed she had shown no remorse and, like the majority of people involved in the case, believed that she was more active in the murders than she admitted.
sentences.zh: 他们认为她没有表现出悔意，并且和案件中的大多数人一样，认为她在谋杀案中比她所承认的更加积极主动

sentences.en: They also lived in fear that Kathy would hunt them down when she was released from prison.
sentences.zh: 他们还生活在恐惧中，担心凯茜出狱后会追杀他们

sentences.en: May Mason's granddaughter, who was particularly vocal in her condemnation of
sentences.zh: 梅·梅森的孙女对谴责

sentences.en: Kathy's parole, armed herself with a gun and top-of-the-line home security.
sentences.zh: 凯茜的假释表现得尤为激进，她配备了一把枪和一流的家庭安防系统

sentences.en: Despite the appeal from the victim's families and considerable public outrage, Kathy Wood was deemed as no longer a threat to society.
sentences.zh: 尽管受害者家属进行了上诉并引发了巨大的公众愤慨，但凯茜·伍德被认为不再对社会构成威胁

sentences.en: At 57 years of age, after serving a 30-year sentence, she was released from prison and moved to South Carolina to live with her sister.
sentences.zh: 在现年57岁、服刑30年后，她被释放出狱，并搬到南卡罗来纳州与她的妹妹同住

sentences.en: A retired detective who worked on the case believed she shouldn't have been paroled, telling local news station Wood TV.
sentences.zh: 一位参与此案的退休侦探认为她本不该获得假释，他在接受当地新闻台木材电视台采访时表示

sentences.en: I believe that Kathy Wood was the mastermind.
sentences.zh: 我相信凯茜·伍德才是幕后主谋

sentences.en: she was the one that was pulling strings on Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 她是那个在幕后操纵格温·格雷厄姆的人

sentences.en: For safety reasons I wouldn't want my grandchildren or elderly residents around her.
sentences.zh: 出于安全考虑，我绝不想让我的孙辈或老年居民在她身边

sentences.en: She's a serial killer and she could do it again and most of them do.
sentences.zh: 她是个连环杀手，她还会再犯，而且大多数这样的人都会重蹈覆辙

sentences.en: With Kathy Wood's parole came the release of court documents previously withheld from the public.
sentences.zh: 随着凯茜·伍德获得假释，先前对公众保密的法庭文件也得以解密

sentences.en: For the first time it was revealed that at one stage Kathy and Gwen were under investigation for a total of 12 deaths at Alpine Manor.
sentences.zh: 这是首次披露，有一段时间凯茜和格温曾因阿尔派庄园的共计12起死亡事件而接受调查

sentences.en: However, a lack of evidence prevented the cases from moving to trial.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于缺乏证据，这些案件未能进入审判程序

sentences.en: Over the years, Kathy and Gwen earned the moniker
sentences.zh: 多年来，凯茜和格温赢得了

sentences.en: The Lethal Lovers.
sentences.zh: 致命恋人这一绰号

sentences.en: A year after the trials, Alpine Manor was sold to a hospital group who extensively renovated and rebranded the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 审判一年后，阿尔派庄园被一家医院集团收购，该集团对这家疗养院进行了大规模翻新和重新包装

sentences.en: Legislation in Michigan was reviewed and nursing homes subject to more stringent conditions.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州的立法得到了重新审视，疗养院也受到了更严格条件的约束

sentences.en: In Michigan today, suspected older abuse in nursing homes must be reported to Adult Protective Services investigators.
sentences.zh: 如今在密歇根州，疗养院中疑似虐待老人的行为必须向成人保护服务调查人员报告

sentences.en: Nursing homes still struggle with the same problems evident at the time of the Alpine
sentences.zh: 疗养院依然在苦苦挣扎于阿尔派

sentences.en: Manor murders.
sentences.zh: 庄园谋杀案时期就显现出的同类问题

sentences.en: An ageing population requiring full-time care, an understaffed workforce and overworked and underpaid nurses are enormous challenges faced in providing care.
sentences.zh: 需要全天候照顾的老龄化人口、人手不足的劳动力以及过度劳累且薪酬过低的护士，都是提供护理时面临的巨大挑战

sentences.en: Current legislation in Michigan dictates that only one certified nursing assistant be required for 8 residents during the day.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州当前的立法规定，在白天每8名居民只需配备一名注册护士助理

sentences.en: At night, one certified nursing assistant can legally be assigned 15 residents to care for.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，一名注册护士助理在法律上可以被指派照顾15名居民

sentences.en: It will probably never be known exactly what motivated Cathie Wood and Gwen Graham.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·伍德和格温·格雷厄姆的动机究竟是什么，可能永远是个谜

sentences.en: A lawyer who represented another nurse convicted of murdering dozens of elderly patients over the span of two decades in Kentucky and Ohio told the Detroit Free Press that,
sentences.zh: 曾代表另一名在肯塔基州和俄亥俄州跨越二十年谋杀数十名老年病人的护士辩护的律师在接受底特律自由报采访时表示

sentences.en: The people that are commonly committing these crimes are those that are rejected by society or feel rejected.
sentences.zh: 通常犯下这些罪行的人都是被社会抛弃或感到被抛弃的人

sentences.en: The only people they can lash out at are those less powerful than they are,
sentences.zh: 他们唯一能发泄的对象是那些比他们弱小的人

sentences.en: The people they care for.
sentences.zh: 也就是他们照顾的人

sentences.en: Before Kathy Wood was sentenced, her ex-husband Ken wrote a letter to the judge.
sentences.zh: 在凯茜·伍德被判刑之前，她的前夫肯给法官写了一封信

sentences.en: In it, he said,
sentences.zh: 在信中，他说

sentences.en: Kathy is guilty of taking lives, or at least not preventing Gwen from taking them.
sentences.zh: 凯茜犯下了剥夺生命的罪行，或者至少没有阻止格温剥夺这些生命

sentences.en: But how much life did she really take?
sentences.zh: 但她真正剥夺了多少生命呢

sentences.en: All of the victims weren't even living.
sentences.zh: 所有的受害者甚至都已经不算在活着了

sentences.en: They enjoyed nothing, experienced nothing, and were going to die.
sentences.zh: 他们享受不到任何乐趣，体验不到任何东西，而且即将死去

sentences.en: This was the opinion voiced by the majority of the public at the time of the murders.
sentences.zh: 这是谋杀案发生时公众普遍持有的观点

sentences.en: The general consensus was that Kathy and Gwen didn't deserve to be sentenced too harshly for their actions because they targeted the weak and sick.
sentences.zh: 共识是，凯茜和格温不应该因她们的行为而被判处过于严厉的刑罚，因为她们的目标是弱者和病人

sentences.en: It was an opinion that devastated the victims' families.
sentences.zh: 这种观点让受害者家属感到心碎

sentences.en: Maxine Luce, the daughter-in-law of victim Myrtle Luce, said that their targeting of the vulnerable was what made their crimes particularly abhorrent.
sentences.zh: 受害人默特尔·露丝的儿媳玛克辛·露丝表示，她们将目标对准弱势群体，正是这一点让她们的罪行极其令人发指

sentences.en: Quote, When I think of Myrtle in that position and someone deliberately cutting off her breath, that's the horror of the thing.
sentences.zh: 原话是，每当我想到默特尔处于那种境地，有人故意掐断她的呼吸，这才是最恐怖的事情

sentences.en: When they're so helpless, like children.
sentences.zh: 当他们像小孩子一样如此无助时

sentences.en: Jan Enderman, Marguerite Chambers' daughter, said to Wood TV that she was devastated that she never got to say goodbye to her mother.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·钱伯斯的女儿简·安德曼对木材电视台说，她感到极其痛心，因为她从未能向母亲道别

sentences.en: Kathy and Gwen took that away from her.
sentences.zh: 凯茜和格温剥夺了她这个权力

sentences.en: John Engman, son-in-law to victim May Mason, said,
sentences.zh: 受害人梅·梅森的女婿约翰·英格曼说

sentences.en: May did not deserve this sort of death.
sentences.zh: 梅不该遭遇这种死法

sentences.en: None of those people did.
sentences.zh: 他们所有人都罪不至此

sentences.en: They lived good lives and expected people would take care of them until they passed from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 他们过着美好的生活，并期望人们会照顾他们，直到他们因自然原因离世
